Main-state dispatch resets stack/work flags, reads a bank plus little-endian handler triplet and maps that bank before the indirect jump.

editorial_audit.notes: Targeted final editorial acceptance for all 2610 current classified regions / 262157 bytes and 1262 semantic units, map SHA256 d32f95247f3c547c153f2215edb55e3ad99070fb0dea4fe852c0f4952229a5f8. See editorial-audit.md and analysis/final-editorial/current-inventory-audit.json; supported scaffold audit alone is baseline-only.

units.name: PlayerInitialize
units.summary: Clear the player record, load stage-dependent position pairs and select the initial animation. The stage selector indexes four-byte records; animation timing comes from the configuration-indexed byte.

units.name: PlayerStateDispatch
units.summary: Set the current object pointer to the player record and dispatch the low three state bits through a little-endian handler table. Other state bits survive this selection.

units.name: PlayerEntryAdvance
units.summary: Advance the scripted entry until the unsigned horizontal position reaches its configured target; then stop horizontal motion, reset animation and advance the player state.

units.name: PlayerUpdate
units.summary: Compose controller state, skip ordinary updates under global/player inhibition, otherwise run collision, horizontal/vertical movement, attack and animation. Finish by rendering and caching the resulting bounds.

units.name: PlayerRenderAndInput
units.summary: Render the current player object and cache its bounds. The following input helper combines the two controller bytes into the player's action mask; later entry scans active object slots for contact.

units.name: PlayerContactDamage
units.summary: Determine the contact side from the signed horizontal difference, set the player reaction bits and pass the contacting object type to the damage table.

units.name: PlayerHorizontalIntent
units.summary: Translate low input direction bits into facing/movement flags. Camera-relative edge checks and the three collision samples on each side can suppress motion; bit 4 inhibits this update.

units.name: PlayerCollisionSamples
units.summary: Commit horizontal flags, then build four horizontal and five vertical probe coordinates by adding signed table offsets to the player position. The shared terrain sampler consumes these pairs.

units.name: PlayerVerticalMotion
units.summary: Resolve landing from the lower collision samples, snap the fractional position to a tile boundary and clear fall velocity. Otherwise apply variable jump acceleration and cap downward velocity at $0300.

units.name: PlayerGroundActions
units.summary: When not already attacking, clear selected movement bits and test the input combination and resource count before calling the secondary-action handler. Unclassified continuation remains separate.

units.name: PlayerJumpAndAttack
units.summary: Update facing from input, start a jump with signed velocity $FD00 and a 16-tick hold timer, and start an attack only when movement/action flags allow it. Attack contact scans active objects in $20-byte steps and tests facing against relative position.

units.name: PlayerHorizontalSpeed
units.summary: Choose one of three signed horizontal velocity pairs from facing/motion flags; the zero pair is the stationary case.

units.name: PlayerFacingAndReaction
units.summary: Copy the facing bit into the render flags. The next entry starts a damage reaction only when its sign flag is set; the intervening unclassified bytes are not decoded here.

units.name: PlayerDamageMotion
units.summary: Start knockback with upward velocity and a timed reaction flag, then apply gravity and cap descent. On landing, stop velocity and clear the reaction bits; depletion handling continues beyond the classified boundary.

units.name: PlayerKnockbackSide
units.summary: Compute camera-relative horizontal position and use the stored contact-side bit to select the subsequent knockback direction.

units.name: PlayerKnockbackSpeed
units.summary: Choose the horizontal knockback pair after right-side collision and camera-edge tests, reusing the ordinary speed loader.

units.name: PlayerAnimationSelect
units.summary: The initial helper stops both velocity pairs. The following selector chooses animation bases from jump, attack, crouch and motion flags; frame advancement uses the animation clock and mask.

units.name: PlayerAnimationAdvance
units.summary: Select airborne/attack animation families and advance bounded frame indices. Attack completion clears action bits and the attached weapon's high flags; frames that are held return without advancing.

units.name: PlayerAnimationRecord
units.summary: Combine the requested animation base with the low two frame bits, multiply by four, then load the sprite pointer and two per-frame attributes. Y also sets the CHR selection shadow.

units.name: ActorInitializeVariant
units.summary: Initialize the current actor once, derive direction from level/player state, select a subtype through a bounded reverse search and install its initial motion and sprite. Exact enemy identity remains unresolved.

units.name: ActorVariantUpdate
units.summary: Skip or retire offscreen/inhibited actors; otherwise run contact, periodic motion, position integration and sprite selection. The velocity helper loads a signed pair and negates it according to direction.

units.name: ActorVerticalWave
units.summary: Use type and a masked timer to select vertical velocity pairs. The later path begins a downward acceleration update once a vertical coordinate reaches its threshold.

units.name: ActorVariantSprite
units.summary: Combine subtype and timer phase to select a sprite pointer, merging subtype flags into the actor's display flags.

units.name: ActorTimedState
units.summary: Test initialization/state bits and level flags before invoking shared actor setup. The ordinary update composes collision, state dispatch, movement and rendering; special states use shared handlers.

units.name: ActorSubstateDispatch
units.summary: Double the actor substate to fetch a little-endian handler pointer and jump through scratch. The table's complete supported domain remains a structural redirect question.

units.name: ActorBounceState
units.summary: On ground contact assign upward velocity and cycle a three-step counter. Subsequent camera-edge tests reverse horizontal direction; grounded transitions choose one of the directional speed pairs.

units.name: ActorGravityAndBounds
units.summary: Build the actor's collision samples and query terrain, then decide whether to apply the shared landing transition or continue gravity according to state and downward velocity.

units.name: ActorGravitySpeed
units.summary: Add $0040 to the vertical velocity and cap it at $0500. A separate entry converts low direction/state bits into a horizontal velocity table index.

units.name: ActorReactionTimer
units.summary: Test reaction bits and decrement the actor timer before selecting a shared reaction handler. Classified fragments do not establish every reaction transition.

units.name: ActorFrameRecord
units.summary: Combine actor frame and phase, load a four-byte sprite/attribute record and copy direction into the display-facing bit. The absolute phase read is retained exactly; its intended sharing is uncertain.

units.name: ActorComplexUpdate
units.summary: Initialize when needed, then combine visibility, reaction, movement, gravity, sprite and rendering helpers. Retirement paths decrement the active count; species identity remains unresolved.

units.name: ActorComplexReaction
units.summary: Select shared reaction routines from the high actor status bits. The following state update tests direction and motion flags before invoking its bounded transition helpers.

units.name: ActorComplexMotion
units.summary: Commit movement flags, select horizontal speed from state and phase, accelerate vertical velocity when enabled, and choose sprite families from motion flags and an animation timer.

units.name: ActorComplexFrameRecord
units.summary: Use a base plus the low three animation bits to select a four-byte record: sprite pointer, attribute and masked actor status bits.

units.name: SceneSetup
units.summary: Initialize PPU shadows, clear scene/collision work arrays and establish scene flags. The following timed event entry selects a resource pointer and queues a PPU transfer when its state becomes active.

units.name: ScenePalettePointer
units.summary: Add the byte offset in A to the scene palette base, preserving carry into the high byte, then tail-call the shared 16-byte palette loader.

units.name: SceneEventUpdate
units.summary: Gate an event on its sign/state bits, then prepare a resource pointer and selector for the scene consumer. Missing continuations are explicitly unclassified.

units.name: SceneTextRequest
units.summary: Store the requested text index and mark the text engine active with bit 7. This only requests a sequence; it does not render it immediately.

units.name: SceneMainLoop
units.summary: Prepare scene display/audio, request dialogue and palette resources, then update text/events once per frame. Start changes the main state. The final entry dispatches scene substates through a word table.

units.name: SceneWaitText
units.summary: Wait for the text engine's completion flag before starting the next event and advancing the scene state.

units.name: SceneBlinkTransfer
units.summary: On a four-frame cadence choose one of two resources from the text flags and frame phase, then queue a fixed-destination PPU transfer.

units.name: SceneTransitionFragment
units.summary: Call common scene initialization. Only this entry fragment is classified here; its caller-specific continuation and scene meaning remain unresolved.

units.name: EndingSceneLoop
units.summary: Initialize the ending scene, repeatedly update dialogue/events and yield a frame. Dispatch the scene state through a little-endian word table; the available fragments do not establish every state.

units.name: EndingDialogueTransitions
units.summary: Wait for particular dialogue IDs and text completion before advancing palette/scroll events. Later fragments select additional dialogue IDs and gate progression on global state bits.

units.name: TextSequenceEngine
units.summary: A sign bit enables the engine; bit 0 controls one-time pointer setup and bit 5 pauses on a timer. Every eighth tick fetch a byte from the indexed text pointer. Bytes $FB–$FE select controls; ordinary bytes queue a tile at a two-row text cursor.

units.name: TextSequenceControls
units.summary: Advance text and cursor indices after an accepted tile. $FE marks completion, $FD resets the cursor, $FC starts a 128-tick pause, and $FB invokes shared helper $E692; its unclassified continuation and complete control semantics remain unresolved.

units.name: SelectionScreenSetup
units.summary: Clear selection work, disable selected rendering bits, initialize palettes and scene state, then wait for PPU setup. Ordinary selection input and dispatch follow at separately classified entries.

units.name: SelectionScreenLoop
units.summary: Render and poll once per frame until Start. Validate the retained input sequence, then select the next main-state byte using the menu index or the recognized-sequence flag.

units.name: SelectionInputHistory
units.summary: Shift nonzero non-Start inputs through an eight-byte history and compare the retained suffix against the embedded sequence. Matching sets the recognition sign flag.

units.name: SelectionDisplay
units.summary: Clear menu work and draw the current selection object. Select cycles an eight-entry index; a two-byte display table updates the rendered selection fields.

units.name: SelectionPaletteSetup
units.summary: Load the same 16-byte resource into both background and sprite palette buffers.

units.name: StageSelectEntryFragment
units.summary: Call the common menu-work clear routine. The rest of this entry remains unclassified and is not inferred from the adjacent selector loop.

units.name: StageSelectAccept
units.summary: Wait for A, map the selected menu index to a stage value, initialize player resources/difficulty and request gameplay state 3. The table lookup supplies the actual stage value, rather than using the menu index directly.

units.name: StageSelectDisplay
units.summary: Render the stage selector; Select cycles ten entries with explicit wrap to zero. A word-sized display table updates the selection object's fields.

units.name: TitleEntryFragment
units.summary: Call title initialization. Only the supported entry fragment is classified here.

units.name: TitleInputLoop
units.summary: Update blinking/palette events and poll a frame until Start or a recognized sequence changes the state. Selection flags choose distinct main-state destinations.

units.name: TitleSequenceMatch
units.summary: Retain recent non-Start input edges and compare several fixed suffixes. Recognized sequences set distinct menu flags; another match sets a low global mode bit.

units.name: TitlePaletteAnimation
units.summary: Every eighth frame advance a three-color palette step until the terminal phase, then count a slower delay. Mark the background palette dirty after each change.

units.name: TitleBlinkPrompt
units.summary: Every 32 frames wait for an empty transfer queue, choose an alternating prompt resource and enqueue it at a fixed nametable address.

units.name: TitleScrollAdvance
units.summary: Increment a two-byte scroll value, wrap its high component to one bit and request OAM refresh. Only this classified prefix is available.

units.name: AudioScreenMask
units.summary: Clear rendering-shadow bits and tail into the shared scroll reset. The following gap is not treated as decoded code.

units.name: AudioSequenceUpdate
units.summary: Select music through a word table, initialize per-channel stream pointers/state and enable four APU channels. Each update arbitrates effects by priority and channel mask, then services effect and music streams with independent duration counters. Channel masks prevent music overwriting active effects.

units.name: AudioStreamDecode
units.summary: Initialize unmasked channel pointers from the music header. Fetch stream bytes until a note/duration or stopping command completes the tick. Notes index timer pairs with an octave shift; pulse/triangle/noise channels take distinct register paths. Control opcodes dispatch indirectly through a word table.

units.name: AudioFetchAndRest
units.summary: Read and advance the selected stream pointer with carry while preserving channel Y. A separate rest handler reloads duration, silences unmasked output and resets envelope state.

units.name: AudioParameterCommands
units.summary: Stream commands set volume/control, sweep, octave and envelope parameters. Octave increment/decrement relies on the decoder's carry contract; preserve the original flags. Exact musical names are tentative beyond these register effects.

units.name: AudioFlowCommands
units.summary: Set envelope targets, push a stream return pointer, return to the previous pointer, or repeat a stream span using a per-channel count. Stack depth/state lives in channel arrays, separate from the CPU hardware stack.

units.name: AudioMarkChannelDone
units.summary: Merge the current channel mask into a music/effect completion mask and return with carry clear, ending further command decoding for that tick.

units.name: AudioEnvelopeUpdate
units.summary: Advance a four-phase per-channel amplitude envelope with programmable rise/fall steps, thresholds and duration. Convert the high nibble to APU volume while retaining channel control bits; terminal phase marks the envelope inactive.

units.name: HudInitialize
units.summary: Initialize HUD tile buffers and field values, clear pending transfers and write the initial HUD rows through PPU helpers. Horizontal and vertical layouts select different address setup paths.

units.name: HudUpdate
units.summary: Refresh changing fields and schedule one pending HUD section. Priority bits select which section is emitted; a word-table dispatcher selects the low-five-bit transfer state.

units.name: HudSectionTransfer
units.summary: Set the PPU destination from a saved address pair and transfer the corresponding tile-buffer section. Completion clears its request bits while preserving other pending sections.

units.name: HudBuffersAndTransfer
units.summary: Mask completed request bits, set PPU addresses, write fixed-size blank or buffered rows, then initialize the 128-byte HUD buffer with blank tiles and embedded templates.

units.name: HudStageDigits
units.summary: Decode a stage-indexed packed byte into two tile digits in the HUD buffer.

units.name: HudLivesDigits
units.summary: Split the packed lives/resource byte into nibbles and refresh the HUD only when those digits change. The following routine builds a repeated-tile meter from its RAM count.

units.name: HudSecondaryMeter
units.summary: Fill a 20-tile meter buffer with blanks, then draw one marker per unit. A cached count suppresses redundant redraw requests; the exact in-game resource is not assumed here.

units.name: HudSelectionInput
units.summary: When the global/player state permits, Select advances a three-way selection and refreshes its four display tiles.

units.name: HudSelectionTiles
units.summary: Use the selection index to load a four-tile display record into two HUD rows.

units.name: HudPackedNumber
units.summary: Expand a packed multi-digit RAM number into six tile digits, compare against the cached HUD buffer and copy only when changed. The shared unpacker supports nibble extraction and leading blanks.

units.name: HudPrimaryMeter
units.summary: Initialize a repeated-tile meter from its resource count. A cached value triggers the corresponding HUD request only after a count change.

units.name: PlayerDamageAndMeter
units.summary: Mask the contacting type, subtract its table-defined damage from the primary count and clamp at zero. The next entry animates another meter toward its target using whole and fractional steps, requesting a HUD update on a frame cadence.

units.name: HudMeterConsume
units.summary: Clear the player request flag, save the displayed meter value, zero its counters and blank the 20-tile display span.

units.name: GameplaySetup
units.summary: Compose level, scroll, HUD, actor and stage-card initialization through fixed-bank helpers. Unclassified calls remain named only where their mechanics are established elsewhere.

units.name: GameplayFrameLoop
units.summary: Run player setup and stage-specific initialization, then each frame synchronize rendering, scrolling, HUD, actor spawning, player dispatch, actor update and progression checks. The special stage value forces the scroll-transition bit.

units.name: GameplayDisplaySetup
units.summary: Clear render work, configure the level and palettes, select IRQ timing and establish display shadows. Initialize HUD CHR shadows and clear selected global status bits before the main loop.

units.name: StageConfigurationIndex
units.summary: Split a stage-indexed packed byte into the low-nibble level selector and high-nibble secondary configuration index.

units.name: GameplayPauseAndEvent
units.summary: Start sets a global pause bit only in the ordinary player state with no overriding action. The next entry begins a stage event when its sign flag is active.

units.name: StageActorInitialization
units.summary: Clear actor state, then apply a special pair of CHR shadow values for level selector 9.

units.name: StageSpecialObjectSetup
units.summary: For selector 9 use the low event bits to fetch stage-specific indices and initialize actor extension data. The remainder is not classified here.

units.name: LevelPaletteSetup
units.summary: Select horizontal/vertical transfer setup from the level mode. Copy indexed stage colors into the sprite palette and select a background palette record, then mark palette buffers for upload.

units.name: GameplayFailureTransition
units.summary: When a global failure bit is set, count down a timer, clear the stage event and update resource/progression state. Stage-index exceptions and delay calls retain their exact values; their game meanings remain tentative.

units.name: GameplayVerticalLimit
units.summary: Fetch a level-dependent coordinate limit and compare the player's vertical position through the shared comparison helper. Crossing it triggers a sound request and the failure-transition path.

units.name: GameplayExitPosition
units.summary: For the selected global state, change player state and compare horizontal position against a camera-relative target. Unclassified continuation determines the eventual transition.

units.name: StageCardDraw
units.summary: Build sprite tiles from indexed stage text plus fixed text resources, advance X by eight per visible tile, and display the card for 120 synchronized frames before restoring level palette setup.

units.name: TextBankWrapper
units.summary: Temporarily map PRG pair 10/11, call the text engine at $8000 and restore pair 2/3. Register values here are effective 8 KiB indices; the fixed-bank wrapper remains mapped throughout.

units.name: ActorPoolClear
units.summary: Clear both actor pages and spawn-history flags, reset counts and select a level-dependent CHR pair unless the special level owns it separately.

units.name: ActorSpawnWindow
units.summary: Walk four-byte spawn records in reverse, skip already spawned IDs, decode nibble-unit coordinates and compare against the current camera strip. Allocate a free $10-byte actor slot, clear its paired extension slot, install coordinates/type/status and mark the spawn ID used.

units.name: ActorFrameDispatch
units.summary: Alternate ascending and descending actor traversal each frame to vary processing order. Skip inactive or masked slots, set the current-object pointer and dispatch type through a word table. Optional bank switches bracket the update when the global mode requires it.

units.name: ActorVisibilityTest
units.summary: Reject actors outside camera-relative margins, choosing horizontal or vertical bounds from the level mode. Carry reports rejection; missing continuation is not assumed to be another accepted branch.

units.name: ActorHorizontalCompare
units.summary: Compare the actor's two-byte horizontal coordinate against the supplied scratch pair, high byte first, returning the comparison flags.

units.name: ActorRetireFragment
units.summary: Use the current actor's saved spawn ID to call the history-reset helper. The classification ends after that call; subsequent retirement behavior remains unresolved.

units.name: ActorStatusClear
units.summary: Clear the middle reaction/status bits while retaining the high bits and initialization bit.

units.name: ActorPlayerRelativeTest
units.summary: The first entry tail-calls a two-axis distance test with a zero high threshold and the player pointer. The next entry compares actor/player horizontal positions and returns a one-bit direction result.

units.name: ActorStopHorizontal
units.summary: Zero the actor's two-byte horizontal velocity without disturbing vertical motion.

units.name: ActorRenderAndBounds
units.summary: Render the current actor, calculate its sprite-derived bounds and cache the resulting two coordinate pairs in the extension record.

units.name: TerrainProbeGrid
units.summary: Query terrain at ten probe-coordinate combinations and store the sampled bytes in the shared collision array. The next entry derives four horizontal/five vertical probe pairs from actor position and a selected offset template.

units.name: AlternateLevelSetupFragment
units.summary: Clear render work and selected PPU mask bits, then call common level initialization. The rest of this entry is unclassified.

units.name: ActionWorkClear
units.summary: Clear the sixteen-byte temporary action record and its activity byte.

units.name: WeaponRenderUpdate
units.summary: For supported animation indices, update an attached object's sprite and signed offsets relative to the player, render it and cache its bounds. This is probably the weapon hitbox; its exact animation association is tentative.

units.name: WeaponVariantPointers
units.summary: Select two word pointers from a four-byte record indexed by the low two variant bits.

units.name: WeaponPositionAndSprite
units.summary: Sign-extend per-frame offsets, mirror horizontal displacement with player facing and add them to player position. A second entry selects sprite/CHR data and copies facing into display flags.

units.name: WeaponActorContact
units.summary: Only an active, enabled and unconsumed attached hitbox can test an eligible actor. A successful overlap sets consumed/contact bits in both records; the shared bounds helper supplies the comparison.

units.name: RestoreActorIndex
units.summary: Reload the current actor index and return, joining the no-contact and successful-contact paths.

units.name: TransientSpriteUpdate
units.summary: If the transient object is active, select its sprite from an animation word table, advance its timer unless globally inhibited, blink selected phases and clear it after the terminal phase.

units.name: SecondaryActionDispatch
units.summary: Gate secondary actions on global/player flags and dispatch a two-bit selection through a word table. A separate active-action path uses another table; neither table's full continuation is inferred here.

units.name: ResetAndMainDispatch
units.summary: Disable interrupts/rendering, initialize stack and mapper IRQ state, synchronize with PPU status, clear RAM work pages and initialize audio/display. Main-state dispatch resets stack/work flags, reads a bank plus little-endian handler triplet and maps that bank before the indirect jump.

units.name: NmiTransfers
units.summary: Preserve CPU state, blank rendering, perform requested OAM DMA and palette uploads, apply CHR shadows and arm the MMC3 scanline IRQ. Dirty bits are cleared when their corresponding upload is serviced.

units.name: NmiFinishAndIrq
units.summary: Prioritize HUD over queued PPU transfers, restore scroll/render shadows, update audio and increment the frame counter before restoring CPU state. The adjacent IRQ entry acknowledges mapper IRQ, checks render/bank-switch guards and chooses split-screen CHR/scroll work.

units.name: IrqSplitScreen
units.summary: Choose a timing-padded scroll update or explicit PPU-address reset from the split flag. Apply lower-screen CHR shadows unless the mapper guard prevents interruption of a main-thread bank switch.

units.name: IrqReturnAndScroll
units.summary: Mix stack-derived bytes into the random-state accumulators, restore CPU state and return from IRQ. A separate entry writes the secondary scroll pair and nametable bits to the PPU shadows/registers.

units.name: WaitFrameAndControllers
units.summary: Preserve registers, read both serial controllers and wait until NMI changes the frame counter. Controller reads shift eight bits and derive newly pressed edges by comparing against the previous held mask. The delay entry repeats this synchronization A times.

units.name: OamAndDisplayRequests
units.summary: Hide unused OAM entries by writing offscreen Y values in four-byte steps; set DMA or palette dirty bits. Scroll-reset helpers clear nametable/scroll shadows without immediate upload.

units.name: SetMirroring
units.summary: Save A in the mirroring shadow and write the MMC3 mirroring register. The hardware uses the appropriate low bit; other stored bits are preserved exactly.

units.name: MapperAndAudioWrappers
units.summary: Bracket MMC3 PRG-pair writes with an IRQ guard and apply CHR shadows. Audio wrappers map pair 12/13, call the audio engine and restore the selected gameplay PRG pair. NMI wrappers honor pause/status bits; unknown callee return-bank contracts remain redirect work.

units.name: AudioPauseCallFragment
units.summary: Invoke the audio pause helper in the currently mapped audio bank. Only this call fragment is classified here.

units.name: AudioControlWrappers
units.summary: Call audio update/start/stop helpers under pair 12/13, restoring the saved PRG pair afterwards. Some entries disable and re-enable NMI around the operation; the selected audio ID is read from its RAM shadow.

units.name: PpuTransferDequeue
units.summary: If the four-slot ring is empty clear its dirty bit. Otherwise copy the selected four-byte record to scratch, advance the ring head/count and optionally apply a resource bank before transferring.

units.name: PpuTransferRows
units.summary: Read width and row count from a transfer stream and choose literal versus repeated-byte output from the width sign bit. Wrap horizontally across nametables and advance destination rows. Attribute-oriented records select a separate eight-column wrapping path.

units.name: PpuTransferAddressing
units.summary: Emit repeated attribute bytes, set/reset the PPU address latch, wrap nametable columns, and advance tile or attribute rows. The list reader walks counted four-byte descriptors. The enqueue entry stores source pointer plus destination pair in a four-slot ring and returns carry on a full queue.

units.name: PaletteBufferLoad
units.summary: Copy a 16-byte palette through an X/Y pointer into background or sprite RAM and set its upload request. Indexed helpers copy four colors into the selected subpalette; index bits select source group and destination quarter.

units.name: PpuScreenTransferLists
units.summary: Install one of two fixed descriptor-list pointers and tail-call the counted transfer-list reader.

units.name: ObjectIntegrateVelocity
units.summary: Add signed velocity components to the object's fractional/integer coordinate fields through the current-object pointer. Two repeated axis helpers propagate carry and sign extension; scratch offsets determine the coordinate and velocity fields.

units.name: ObjectSpriteRender
units.summary: Read the object's sprite pointer and coordinates, optionally subtract camera position and facing offsets, then expand a layout record into OAM pieces. Mirror per-piece offsets, reject offscreen high bytes, combine palette/flip flags and alternate traversal order by frame parity. OAM insertion stops at 64 sprites.

units.name: BoundsAndTerrainLookup
units.summary: Compare sprite-derived bounds in two axes using lookup radii, returning overlap flags. The adjacent terrain reader converts level coordinates to a collision-map byte, selecting a page by level mode and normalized row.

units.name: DistanceAndPackedData
units.summary: Compare absolute two-byte coordinate distances against thresholds, reverse-search a byte table, multiply an eight-bit value with optional sign extension of its factor and expand packed nibbles with leading-blank handling. These are shared scratch-based helpers; callers determine their game meaning.

units.name: SpawnHistoryAccess
units.summary: Index the spawn-history flag array using A; the read entry returns the flag and the write entry marks it as one.

units.name: ObjectSpriteBounds
units.summary: Use the sprite-layout index to load signed bounds offsets, mirror horizontal displacement when facing is set and add them to the object's two-byte coordinates. Return the two resulting coordinate pairs in scratch.

units.name: LevelInitialize
units.summary: Select stage configuration and decode the level record, then choose mirroring from level mode. Clear transfer work, initialize camera/tile strips and set the initial redraw flag.

units.name: LevelCameraOrigin
units.summary: Reset low camera components, load stage-specific high components and derive the normalized vertical origin through the row-offset helper.

units.name: LevelRowOffset
units.summary: Look up a two-byte offset from the row index and add the saved low component to form the vertical camera coordinate.

units.name: LevelInitialStrips
units.summary: Align the camera to tile boundaries, select horizontal or vertical strip construction and iterate the initial screen margin. Both paths restore coordinates before returning; unclassified alternatives remain opaque.

units.name: LevelRecordDecode
units.summary: Map the resource bank and build a strip, optionally uploading it immediately. The record loader calculates a 21-byte stage descriptor and unpacks palette IDs, three thresholds, CHR banks, audio ID, mode and seven two-byte resource pointers. Field meanings follow their consumers; unknown pointer formats remain unresolved.

units.name: LevelStripBuild
units.summary: When redraw is requested and no previous strip is pending, derive source/collision pointers, walk 12 or 16 metatiles by orientation, expand graphics and attributes, update collision storage and mark the strip ready for NMI.

units.name: LevelCollisionPageCopy
units.summary: Copy an alternate collision-map page back to the primary page. Only the classified fragment is explained; the loop's unclassified continuation is not reconstructed.

units.name: CameraFollowHorizontal
units.summary: Center the camera target 128 pixels behind the player with a zero clamp. Compare with the current camera and level boundary metadata, choose forward/backward strip updates and set a transition flag at the limit. Exact transition semantics remain tentative.

units.name: CameraBackwardFragment
units.summary: Return from the forward path or invoke the backward-strip helper. The intervening unclassified loop is not inferred.

units.name: CameraLimitFlag
units.summary: Set the level mode's transition bit and return; callers determine which stage transition follows.

units.name: ScrollCoordinateNormalize
units.summary: Convert camera coordinates into PPU scroll and nametable shadows. Normalize vertical values using 240-pixel rows, then derive the next strip's tile coordinate and destination nametable address according to orientation.

units.name: MetatileStripSource
units.summary: Read the row selector, turn it into a byte offset and add the level's layout pointer. Orientation determines the stride. The adjacent helper samples neighboring metatiles on even/odd strip boundaries for attribute construction.

units.name: MetatileNeighborVertical
units.summary: Choose the preceding vertical neighbor pointer and initialize the alternate sample selector for the shared attribute helper.

units.name: MetatileNeighborSample
units.summary: Combine row parity with a neighbor selector, fetch the metatile byte and tail-call the common quadrant-attribute packer.

units.name: MetatileAttributePack
units.summary: Derive the attribute quadrant from strip/tile parity. High-bit metatiles use a table; ordinary metatiles use three thresholds to select one of four palettes. Merge that palette's shifted two bits into the packed attribute buffer.

units.name: MetatileTileExpand
units.summary: Select the normal or high-bit alternate tile-definition base, multiply the metatile index by four and copy its four tiles into orientation-dependent row buffers. Only supported stores are classified here.

units.name: CollisionStripStore
units.summary: Select the collision page from coordinate parity, add the strip offset and store each metatile byte using horizontal or vertical stride. Completion clears redraw and marks the PPU strip dirty.

units.name: ScreenRevealGrid
units.summary: Iterate a table of packed grid coordinates, derive nametable positions, expand metatiles and queue transfers. Advance the reveal index on a four-frame cadence until $C1 entries, then restore the display-control shadow.

units.name: ScreenRevealMetatile
units.summary: Choose a layout pointer from camera/page parity and fetch the metatile at the selected grid coordinate.

units.name: ScreenRevealTransfer
units.summary: Resolve the metatile's four tile bytes using the normal or alternate definition base, place them in a transfer buffer and enqueue a 2-by-2 PPU update.

units.name: AttributeStripUpload
units.summary: Convert the pending tile-strip address to attribute-table coordinates. Horizontal strips upload six bytes eight addresses apart; vertical strips upload eight contiguous bytes after resetting the PPU latch.

units.name: SpecialRoomRowSelectors
units.summary: Shared row selectors 0, 0, $FF. The terminator bounds this three-byte list; the two room rows select the same layout page. The shared spawn pointer is outside these accepted data slices.

units.name: SpecialRoomLayoutVariant0
units.summary: One 192-byte room layout. Each cell selects a normal/alternate metatile definition; the corresponding 22-byte definition block is bounded separately. Several descriptors share row and palette pointers; these variants must not be treated as consecutive complete resource records.

units.name: SpecialRoomMetatileVariant0
units.summary: Bounded metatile definitions for the preceding special-room layout: one normal tile and four alternate tiles. Layout-index checks establish this slice; the shared palette lies elsewhere.

units.name: SpecialRoomSharedPalette
units.summary: Shared four-byte palette slice for special-room metatiles. Descriptor palette pointers are nonlocal; they do not give the endpoint of each variant's definition block.

units.name: SpecialRoomLayoutVariant1
units.summary: One 192-byte room layout. Each cell selects a normal/alternate metatile definition; the corresponding 22-byte definition block is bounded separately. Several descriptors share row and palette pointers; these variants must not be treated as consecutive complete resource records.

units.name: SpecialRoomMetatileVariant1
units.summary: Bounded metatile definitions for the preceding special-room layout: one normal tile and four alternate tiles. Layout-index checks establish this slice; the shared palette lies elsewhere.

units.name: SpecialRoomLayoutVariant2
units.summary: One 192-byte room layout. Each cell selects a normal/alternate metatile definition; the corresponding 22-byte definition block is bounded separately. Several descriptors share row and palette pointers; these variants must not be treated as consecutive complete resource records.

units.name: SpecialRoomMetatileVariant2
units.summary: Bounded metatile definitions for the preceding special-room layout: one normal tile and four alternate tiles. Layout-index checks establish this slice; the shared palette lies elsewhere.

units.name: SpecialRoomLayoutVariant3
units.summary: One 192-byte room layout. Each cell selects a normal/alternate metatile definition; the corresponding 22-byte definition block is bounded separately. Several descriptors share row and palette pointers; these variants must not be treated as consecutive complete resource records.

units.name: SpecialRoomMetatileVariant3
units.summary: Bounded metatile definitions for the preceding special-room layout: one normal tile and four alternate tiles. Layout-index checks establish this slice; the shared palette lies elsewhere.

units.name: SpecialRoomLayoutVariant4
units.summary: One 192-byte room layout. Each cell selects a normal/alternate metatile definition; the corresponding 22-byte definition block is bounded separately. Several descriptors share row and palette pointers; these variants must not be treated as consecutive complete resource records.

units.name: SpecialRoomMetatileVariant4
units.summary: Bounded metatile definitions for the preceding special-room layout: one normal tile and four alternate tiles. Layout-index checks establish this slice; the shared palette lies elsewhere.

units.name: SpecialRoomLayoutVariant5
units.summary: One 192-byte room layout. Each cell selects a normal/alternate metatile definition; the corresponding 22-byte definition block is bounded separately. Several descriptors share row and palette pointers; these variants must not be treated as consecutive complete resource records.

units.name: SpecialRoomMetatileVariant5
units.summary: Bounded metatile definitions for the preceding special-room layout: one normal tile and four alternate tiles. Layout-index checks establish this slice; the shared palette lies elsewhere.

units.name: LevelResourcesSet0Part0
units.summary: Level resource container for descriptor 0, mapped through effective PRG pair 6/7. Row selectors lead to 192-byte layout pages; layout bytes select normal or alternate metatile definitions. Palette bytes and the count-headed four-byte spawn list follow. The spawn header stores the highest record index, so its extent is 1 + 4*(header+1), not 1 + 4*header. Container boundaries follow this descriptor, not an assumed chain into the next descriptor. Mixed internal details and natural descriptor selection remain uncertain.

The spawn header stores the highest record index, so its extent is 1 + 4*(header+1), not 1 + 4*header. Container boundaries follow this descriptor, not an assumed chain into the next descriptor. units.name: StageResourceDescriptors
units.summary: Eighteen 21-byte descriptors decoded by DecodeLevelDescriptor. The stage configuration high nibble selects the descriptor; the low nibble separately becomes LevelSelector. Fields supply display configuration, effective resource PRG pair, row/layout/metatile/palette and spawn pointers. Shared and nonmonotone pointers are valid here; no universal concatenation rule is implied.

units.name: ActorState8870HandlerWords

units.name: ActorState9F18HandlerWords

units.name: ActorState92D9HandlerWords
units.summary: Actor subdispatch words under effective PRG pair 0/1. Supported selector contract: mask02 gives offsets0,2. Values outside that supported slice do not justify additional handler or table classification.

units.name: SceneSequenceA0DBHandlerWords
units.summary: Bounded little-endian scene-step pointer slice (11 words), consumed by the SceneStep-indexed dispatcher at CPU $A0DB under effective PRG pair 2/3. Handler state changes support these entries; the complete selector domain is not established.

units.name: SceneSequenceA5ACHandlerWords

units.summary: Bounded little-endian scene-step pointer slice (8 words), consumed by the SceneStep-indexed dispatcher at CPU $A848 under effective PRG pair 2/3. Handler state changes support these entries; the complete selector domain is not established.

units.name: SceneSequenceAB38HandlerWords
units.summary: Bounded little-endian scene-step pointer slice (6 words), consumed by the SceneStep-indexed dispatcher at CPU $AB38 under effective PRG pair 2/3. Handler state changes support these entries; the complete selector domain is not established.

units.name: SceneSequenceB678HandlerWords

units.name: SceneSequenceB806HandlerWords

units.name: AudioControlHandlerWords
units.summary: Twenty little-endian handler words for stream controls $0C through $1F. The decoder checks this range, subtracts $0C and doubles the result. The following fetch helper independently bounds the table. A handler's carry result either continues decoding or ends the current channel tick.

units.name: IntroSequenceHandlerWords
units.summary: Eleven little-endian state handler words, indexed by SceneStep. Initial state is zero; successive handlers advance the step, while the final handler starts a main-state transition. This is a bounded pointer slice; unrestricted state values and natural selection remain unproven.

units.name: ActorTypeHandlerWords
units.summary: 104 little-endian actor-handler words, bounded by the following fixed-bank routine. The type-bank selection supplies the switchable-bank contract; pointer bytes alone do not establish the full runtime ActorType domain or prove any particular handler naturally selected.

units.name: SpecialActorStageMatches
units.summary: Six stage values tested by reverse search. A match selects the same-index template word; failure retains the caller's separate fallback path.

units.name: SpecialActorTemplateWords
units.summary: Six little-endian template addresses selected by the exact-match stage table immediately before this slice. Template count/header fields govern initialization, not arbitrary pointer use.

units.name: SpecialActorInitializationTemplates
units.summary: Count/header-controlled actor initialization templates consumed by the special-bank setup routine. These bytes initialize actor records; exact game roles of individual variants remain open.

units.name: TextTransferFailureReturn
units.summary: Rejoin the ordinary text-transfer retry path; the input byte/cursor must remain unadvanced when the queue rejects a transfer.

units.name: TextResetCursorControl
units.summary: Reset the text cursor to zero and resume the shared control-byte completion path.

units.name: MenuEnableDisplayAfterTransfers
units.summary: Queue the three menu transfer lists, initialize display shadows and enable background/sprite rendering. Set the global menu/display flag before falling into the existing menu loop.

units.name: MenuQueueThreeTransferLists
units.summary: Submit three fixed count-headed transfer lists through the shared PPU queue walker; the final submission is a tail call.

units.name: StageMenuPrepareDisplay
units.summary: Disable rendering, reset scroll/OAM, install the menu palette and transfer lists, then initialize display shadows and restore rendering. The following source continues the menu loop.

units.name: StageMenuQueueTransferLists
units.summary: Queue three stage-menu display transfer lists. Each source list owns its count and destination records.

units.name: StageMenuLoadPalettes
units.summary: Load the same sixteen-byte palette source into sprite and background palette buffers.

units.name: SceneRenderMetatilePanel
units.summary: A selects a twelve-byte panel descriptor. Copy it into scratch, expand sixteen metatiles per row into a 64-byte tile buffer and write successive PPU rows; then copy the descriptor's attribute bytes. Rendering must already be in a state permitting direct PPUDATA writes.

units.name: SceneExpandPanelRow
units.summary: Use the row number to select sixteen layout cells. Each cell indexes a four-byte metatile definition, laid out into two adjacent tile rows in the $0300 buffer.

units.name: SceneMenuInitializeDisplay
units.summary: Disable rendering and clear display state, install palettes and the initial metatile panel, queue menu overlays and enable rendering. Start audio selection zero. The audio return requires MainPrgPair to describe the caller's effective pair 12/13.

units.name: SceneMenuResetStepAndWait
units.summary: Clear scene step and auxiliary countdown, then wait one sixty-frame interval with OAM refresh requests. Continuation retains the caller's bank-shadow precondition.

units.name: SceneMenuStartGameTransition
units.summary: Install initial player/resource values, clear secondary scroll, increment the transition byte and enter main state $12. ChangeMainState resets the stack; this tail does not return normally.

units.name: SceneMenuAlternateTransition
units.summary: Enter main state $0F. The following separately callable helper clears secondary scroll shadows.

units.name: SceneClearSecondaryScroll
units.summary: Clear the secondary X/Y scroll and nametable shadows without changing the main camera.

units.name: SceneClearWorkingRecords
units.summary: Clear the 32-byte scene-step workspace and two $C0-byte work spans. The second loop intentionally visits offsets $C0 down through one.

units.name: SelectionMenuRefreshAfterWait
units.summary: Wait for a frame, recheck the secondary nametable transition, clear menu tile workspace, reload palette and service the two selection inputs and confirmation helper.

units.name: SelectionMenuCheckAudioStop
units.summary: Test the shifted controller edge for the stop action and call the audio-stop wrapper. Its return mapping depends on MainPrgPair matching this caller.

units.name: SelectionMenuInputReturn
units.summary: Return from the shared selection-input path when no further action is needed.

units.name: SelectionMenuAdjustFirstChoice
units.summary: Update the first menu choice from vertical input, wrapping over 19 values. Convert the selection to packed decimal display nibbles and queue its two-digit transfer.

units.name: SelectionMenuAdjustSecondChoice
units.summary: Update the second menu choice from horizontal input, wrapping over 28 values. Convert it to display nibbles and queue the second two-digit transfer.

units.name: SelectionMenuConvertNumber
units.summary: Convert the selection byte to packed decimal using the shared binary-to-decimal helper with a three-digit output width. Scratch pointers select the result buffer.

units.name: SelectionMenuQueueOverlays
units.summary: Queue two counted transfer lists for the selection-menu overlay, tail-calling the second list walker.

units.name: SceneMenuLoadPalettes
units.summary: Install separate sprite/background palettes for this menu scene.

units.name: InitializePlayerMenuDefaults
units.summary: Set initial player configuration bytes, resource selection and two lives; clear the player timing/configuration index. Exact meanings of the four unnamed configuration fields remain uncertain.

units.name: ContinuePromptInitialize
units.summary: Hide sprites, prepare the display and direct tile transfer, enable rendering and start audio selection $0E. Return from the audio wrapper requires a matching MainPrgPair shadow.

units.name: ContinuePromptWaitForStart
units.summary: Refresh OAM and wait for Start. Reset lives and the saved progression/configuration bytes, then enter main state three through the stack-reset transition.

units.name: ContinuePromptLoadPalette
units.summary: Load the background palette for the continue prompt.

units.name: AudioSetEnvelopeRise
units.summary: Fetch one stream byte and store this channel's envelope rise step; later entry points set decay, sustain and timescale independently.

units.name: AudioSetEnvelopeDecay
units.summary: Fetch and store the channel envelope decay step.

units.name: AudioSetEnvelopeSustain
units.summary: Fetch and store the channel envelope sustain byte.

units.name: AudioSetEnvelopeTimeScale
units.summary: Fetch and store the channel envelope timescale byte.

units.name: AudioRestoreNestedStreamPointer
units.summary: Restore the previous two-byte stream pointer from the next depth slot. X already selects the channel/depth pair; carry set asks the command decoder to continue.

units.name: AudioMarkChannelStateAndYield
units.summary: Set this channel's bit in the music-state mask and return carry clear to end decoding for this tick.

units.name: AddActorTypePackedReward
units.summary: Mask the current actor type to seven bits, fetch its two-byte packed reward and add three packed-decimal bytes into the shared accumulator. The game meaning of that accumulator is not required by this arithmetic contract.

units.name: LevelTransitionEnableRedraw
units.summary: Set level-mode bit two and initialize the level display. This is a continuation under the accepted caller/bank contract.

units.name: FadeBackgroundPaletteToBlack
units.summary: Wait for every eighth frame, reduce each background color by one brightness band and clamp below zero to $0F. Request uploads until all sixteen entries are black.

units.name: SaveDisplayBeforeSceneTransition
units.summary: Save both palette buffers in temporary RAM, save mapping/display shadows and camera state, then map effective pair 12/13. The palette copy temporarily reuses the text-workspace area.

units.name: SaveMainMappingShadows
units.summary: Copy zero-page bytes zero through eight to their saved counterparts at $0A through $12, preserving the current display/main-bank shadows.

units.name: ActorBottomCameraWindowCheck
units.summary: Continue camera-window rejection by comparing actor Y against CameraY+$00D0 through the common unsigned comparison helper. Carry controls the caller's existing rejection path.

units.name: ActorCompareYWithScratch
units.summary: Load current actor Y and tail-call the shared comparison against Scratch18/19.

units.name: ActorClearSharedFlag
units.summary: Clear the shared actor flag at $05A9 before falling into the previously reviewed continuation. Its higher-level game meaning remains uncertain.

units.name: DeactivateCurrentActor
units.summary: Clear the current actor's active/display byte; retain all other actor fields.

units.name: ActorComparePlayerDistance
units.summary: Point the second operand at the player record and tail-call the shared two-axis distance comparison. The caller supplies its threshold and current-object pointer.

units.name: ActorResetAnimation
units.summary: Clear current actor animation frame and timer. The following entry joins the existing motion-reset path.

units.name: ActorResetMotionEntry
units.summary: Select the current slot and clear vertical velocity through the shared helper before continuing the existing motion reset.

units.name: ActorClearVerticalVelocity
units.summary: Clear both bytes of the selected actor's vertical velocity without changing horizontal velocity.

units.name: ActorStartFlashTimer
units.summary: Set actor status bit five and start the $20-tick flash timer. Subsequent helpers clear reaction bits or combine timer/facing bits into the display flags.

units.name: ActorClearReactionBits
units.summary: Clear actor status bits four through six while preserving bit seven and the low nibble.

units.name: ActorAdvanceFlashDisplay
units.summary: Use the flash timer's low two bits for sprite display flags and decrement the timer.

units.name: ActorRestoreDirectionDisplay
units.summary: Replace the two display-direction bits with the actor's saved direction field.

units.name: ActorServiceContactReaction
units.summary: Run the shared contact helper, then service reaction/flash state according to status bits six and five. Completed flashing restores display direction, clears reaction bits and applies accumulated damage.

units.name: FindAvailableActorSlotAlternate
units.summary: Scan sixteen $10-byte actor slots for a nonnegative inactive/display byte. Carry clear reports a free slot in Y; carry set reports exhaustion.

units.name: FindActiveActorOfDifferentType
units.summary: Scan active slots whose type is at least two. Return when a type differs from A's supplied type; otherwise continue until the slot index wraps. Preserve the final comparison flags.

units.name: SampleCurrentActorTerrain
units.summary: Copy actor X/Y into the terrain sampler's coordinate scratch and tail-call the fixed-bank terrain lookup.

units.name: ActorAccumulateContactDamage
units.summary: Look up the actor's damage threshold, compute a contact increment and accumulate it with carry. Set status bit seven when the accumulated value exceeds the type threshold.

units.name: ActorSelectContactIncrement
units.summary: Choose the contact increment from progression/selection and actor reaction state. The caller supplies current actor X; alternate selection and reaction paths use separate table slices.

units.name: ActorSelectOverrideIncrement
units.summary: Combine the player override bit and progression selector to index the alternate contact-increment table.

units.name: ActorConvertToReactionState
units.summary: If coordinates are outside the signed positive world, clear scene work state. Otherwise award the type-dependent packed reward, reset motion/animation and replace type/status/motion/attribute from a four-byte reaction record; request sound $17.

units.name: ActorConvertAlternateReaction
units.summary: Award the same reward but select the second four-byte reaction record before joining the shared actor conversion.

units.name: CopyActorTypeAndPosition
units.summary: Copy the supplied type and current actor's two-byte X/Y into destination slot Y. Slot allocation and other destination fields belong to the caller.

units.name: LevelDisplayTransitionPrepare
units.summary: Hide sprites, prepare transition state and wait for display synchronization before setting level redraw mode and initializing the display.

units.name: AuxiliaryActorEnsureInitialized
units.summary: Call the auxiliary-record initializer before continuing the previously reviewed actor path.

units.name: InitializeAuxiliaryActorRecord
units.summary: Initialize the auxiliary actor record only when its display byte is inactive. Copy saved X/Y coordinates and clear its animation counters; preserve an already active record.

units.name: WaitSixtyFrameIntervals
units.summary: A supplies the number of intervals. Each iteration requests OAM DMA and waits sixty frames; callers must provide a nonzero count to avoid the byte-counter wraparound case.

units.name: WriteAttributeTransferColumns
units.summary: Finish the pending attribute transfer using the current horizontal offset to bound the first run. Wrap nametable columns and advance attribute rows until both counts are exhausted.

units.name: QueueCountedTransfersInReverse
units.summary: Read a count followed by four-byte source/destination records. Visit records from the count down to one; enqueue each, waiting for a frame and retrying when the four-slot PPU queue is full. The source pointer and count stay in scratch across retries.

units.name: QuantizePlayerActorDirection
units.summary: Compute absolute player-to-actor bound-center differences and retain their signs. Compare scaled axis magnitudes against successive thresholds, then combine sector and sign bits to select a direction byte. This is an integer sector approximation, not an exact angle calculation.

units.name: AddPackedDecimalByteClamped
units.summary: Add the supplied one-byte packed decimal value through the shared decimal adder; on overflow return $99. Scratch18/19 ownership remains with the caller.

units.name: AddPackedDecimalArrays
units.summary: Add two arrays of packed decimal bytes with low/high-nibble decimal correction and carry propagation. Scratch20/21 and Scratch22/23 are source/destination pointers; A supplies the byte count.

units.name: ConvertBinaryToPackedDecimal
units.summary: Repeatedly subtract three-byte powers of ten from the binary value, count each decimal digit and pack adjacent nibbles into the output pointer. X supplies the requested digit width; scratch holds the remaining value and current digit.

units.name: ClearSpawnHistoryEntry
units.summary: A selects the spawn-history byte to clear, permitting that spawn record to be considered again.

units.name: SetObjectVelocityFromDirection
units.summary: Mask A to a 32-direction index. Fetch signed X/Y factors and scale them by the supplied magnitudes using the shared multiply helper, then store two-byte velocities in the current object's fields $0A..$0D.

units.name: SaveCameraCoordinates
units.summary: Copy both two-byte camera coordinates into the saved camera shadows at $E8..$EB.

units.name: PlayerAdvanceThreeFrameAnimation
units.summary: Advance the player animation every sixteen animation-clock ticks. On reaching frame three, join the existing animation-completion path; other ticks preserve the selected frame.

units.name: PlayerReleaseAnimationOverride
units.summary: Keep the override animation while its state/timer condition holds. Once the override clears, remove motion bit four and return without disturbing the other motion flags.

units.name: ActorFamily27InitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Initialize actor types $27..$2C only after camera/distance and shared-slot conditions pass. Type $2C uses level-mode and competing-type checks; other types require the shared $05A9 flag to be free. Initialize display direction once, then run contact, reaction and family motion updates unless global/player state inhibits them.

units.name: ActorFamily27FinishUpdate
units.summary: Integrate family motion, render active actors, or remove/convert them on rejection and terminal status. The later family selector combines relative facing with motion flags and dispatches ActorType-$27 through the six-word bounded table.

units.name: ActorFamily27SelectMotion
units.summary: Reject incompatible status/motion bits, derive facing bits from the player relation and dispatch the $27..$2C family. The caller must supply a supported type in this six-entry domain.

units.name: ActorFamily27ChooseAction
units.summary: Use two-axis player distance and player motion to choose idle, movement or attack flags. Related entries add free-slot and random-mask gates; all join the same motion-flag merge and animation reset.

units.name: ActorFamily28ChooseAction
units.summary: Choose the related family action using outer/inner distance thresholds, random gating and available actor slots. Preserve low motion-direction bits while replacing the action bits.

units.name: ActorFamilyMotionAndReaction
units.summary: Build actor collision probes, apply the appropriate movement/collision helper and join shared reaction conversion. A second entry uses the alternate movement helper.

units.name: ActorFamilyAlternateMotionAndReaction
units.summary: Build the same probe template, run alternate collision/motion handling and join shared reaction conversion.

units.name: ActorApplyVerticalVelocitySequence
units.summary: Index a two-byte vertical velocity sequence with the actor counter. Increment the counter and clear motion bit seven when counter bit five becomes set.

units.name: ActorFamily27AnimateReaction
units.summary: Service contact reaction and landing before normal animation. Reaction starts a flash timer and resets animation; descending actors stop on supported terrain and align to an eight-pixel row. Normal paths select idle/move/attack/recovery frame groups from motion flags and reset flags when each finite animation completes.

units.name: ActorFamily27AdvanceAnimation
units.summary: Advance the actor timer and choose normal animation from variant and motion bits. Frame masks/counts control finite action completion; recovery clears its status/action flags after the timer interval.

units.name: ActorFamily27EmitEffect
units.summary: Allocate an effect and choose its initial frame/vertical offset from the random direction bit. The allocation precondition belongs to the preceding free-slot check.

units.name: ActorFamily27LoadFrame
units.summary: Combine the animation group with the low two frame bits and load a four-byte sprite/attribute/work record. X is the current actor slot; the work byte at $06 is shared scratch.

units.name: ActorTimedTransitionEffect
units.summary: Animate a timed effect in four-tick frame steps, advancing its motion sequence until the configured count. On completion search the saved variant through three transition lists, set the corresponding global flags, clear related actors and enter the shared display transition.

units.name: ActorEffectSelectTransitionFlags
units.summary: Search three bounded variant lists and set the matching global-state mask. The lists distinguish related transition effects; exact game event names remain uncertain.

units.name: ActorEffectClearRelatedActors
units.summary: Clear active records matching the special type/direction condition, reduce player motion to its facing bit and clear override/work flags before the fixed-bank transition. The following helper loads signed high-byte velocities from an effect frame table.

units.name: ActorEffectLoadVelocity
units.summary: Index signed horizontal/vertical high-byte velocity pairs by effect frame and integrate through the shared current-object helper.

units.name: SpawnActorType3EffectA
units.summary: Initialize a new type-three effect at the current actor position, copy facing and select its first sprite. Caller must have established an available destination slot.

units.name: SpawnActorType3EffectB
units.summary: Initialize the related type-three effect with the alternate sprite; position and facing handling are shared with the first variant.

units.name: CopyPositionAsType3Effect
units.summary: Supply type three to the shared actor type/position copier. The next entry transfers display-facing and derives its motion-direction bit.

units.name: CopyActorFacingToNewSlot
units.summary: Merge the source actor facing into destination display flags, then derive destination motion direction. A supplies the destination base display flags; X/Y select source/destination.

units.name: SpawnOppositeFacingType6Effect
units.summary: Create type six with opposite facing, a fixed sprite and a sixteen-pixel upward offset. A related entry retains facing with an alternate sprite and joins the same vertical-offset helper.

units.name: SpawnForwardFacingType6Effect
units.summary: Create the forward-facing type-six effect, select its alternate sprite and join the common upward-offset path.

units.name: ActorType6Update
units.summary: Respect global/player inhibition, camera rejection and contact terminal state. Otherwise sample terrain, stop/reset vertical motion, load the direction-indexed horizontal velocity and integrate before rendering; terminal contact awards the type reward and removes the slot.

units.name: ActorType6AlternateUpdate
units.summary: Run the related type-six motion path without the terrain rejection used by its companion. Camera/contact rejection, player inhibition and reward/removal share the same tails.

units.name: SpawnTwoRotatingEffects
units.summary: Derive two direction/phase combinations from relative facing and random bytes, then attempt two effect allocations. Each receives type eight, a finite lifetime, angle and angle increment; allocation failure returns without writing a slot.

units.name: SpawnRotatingEffectFromScratch
units.summary: Allocate a type-eight effect using the direction, starting angle and angle increment held in scratch. Initialize its sprite, position and lifetime before returning the destination slot.

units.name: ActorRotatingEffectUpdate
units.summary: Reject off-camera or terminal actors, otherwise advance time, rotate the direction at four-tick intervals, derive velocities and integrate. Alternate two sprites from timer bit three; terminal contact awards reward and removes the slot.

units.name: ActorRotateVelocityAndLifetime
units.summary: Every fourth timer tick decrement lifetime, advance the angle modulo 32 and install directional velocity with magnitudes $14/$08.

units.name: ActorRotatingEffectSelectSprite
units.summary: Use timer bit three to alternate between the two effect sprite pointers.

units.name: SpawnFourCameraRelativeActors
units.summary: Attempt four allocations, indexing position pairs from direction and a descending counter. Place each type-$0A actor relative to the camera and initialize its direction-dependent velocity; stop immediately when no free slot remains.

units.name: ActorFallingEffectUpdate
units.summary: Apply camera/contact/player-state checks, integrate the fixed falling trajectory, alternate sprites and render. Terminal contact awards reward before deactivation; the later initializer derives facing and horizontal velocity from motion direction.

units.name: InitializeFallingEffectVelocity
units.summary: Derive sprite facing and signed horizontal velocity from the destination motion bit, and initialize downward vertical velocity to $0400.

units.name: ActorFallingEffectSelectSprite
units.summary: Alternate the falling effect's two sprite pointers using timer bit two.

units.name: SpawnAimedActorAboveSource
units.summary: Initialize type $0C at the source actor's position minus $48 vertically, copy facing and install its fixed sprite. The caller supplies a previously checked destination slot.

units.name: ActorDelayedAimUpdate
units.summary: Wait sixteen timer ticks before enabling this actor, quantize the player-relative direction and install equal-magnitude directional velocity. Then apply camera/contact/player-state checks and integrate/render; terminal actors award reward before deactivation.

units.name: ActorTimedEmitterUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display and frame attributes once the player-distance gate passes. While active, service contact/reaction, advance the timer and animation, and periodically emit a two-actor pattern with alternating orientations.

units.name: ActorTimedEmitterReaction
units.summary: Service the actor's status-controlled flash/reaction path and apply accumulated contact damage at its supported completion point.

units.name: ActorTimedEmitterAnimateAndSpawn
units.summary: Select sprite pairs from timer phases. At timer $20, emit a paired pattern if close enough; at phase $50 clear activation status and reset the timer for another cycle.

units.name: ActorOscillatorInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display, direction and frame attributes once. Under normal global/player state, advance time, service contact reaction and dispatch its two motion modes; shared tails render or convert/remove the actor.

units.name: ActorOscillatorFinishAndDispatch
units.summary: Render a live oscillator or convert it after terminal contact. During player override, retain the shared reaction path. The later dispatcher masks motion bit one, giving exactly two handler words.

units.name: ActorOscillatorDispatchMode
units.summary: Use motion bit one as an exact two-word selector; the table's offsets are zero and two, with other flag bits ignored.

units.name: ActorOscillatorContactReaction
units.summary: On contact reaction reverse facing, set the alternate motion mode and start flash/damage handling. On completion restore display/status and enter a controlled movement state.

units.name: ActorOscillatorHorizontalMode
units.summary: Measure actor X relative to the camera. Near screen edges set/clear the mode bit and face toward the player, then load horizontal/vertical velocities and run the common firing gate.

units.name: ActorOscillatorFacePlayer
units.summary: Replace the motion-facing bit with the shared player-relative direction result, preserving other motion state.

units.name: ActorOscillatorVerticalMode
units.summary: Use actor Y thresholds and camera-relative X to select vertical direction and occasional player-facing mode changes. Stop horizontal motion before loading the signed vertical-velocity pair.

units.name: ActorOscillatorTryFire
units.summary: Require supported terrain, close player distance, no active firing frame and a clear random mask before setting attack flags and allocating a child. Failed terrain clears the firing state and frame index.

units.name: ActorOscillatorLoadHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Combine motion direction and bit two to select one of the horizontal velocity pairs.

units.name: ActorOscillatorLoadVerticalSequence
units.summary: Use timer bits two through five to index a two-byte vertical velocity sequence.

units.name: ActorOscillatorSelectSprite
units.summary: Derive a two-word sprite selection from motion bits and copy its pointer into the current actor.

units.name: SpawnOscillatorChild
units.summary: Allocate a type-four child at the source position, set its reaction state and derive its motion sign from the source actor's direction. The fixed sprite and frame attribute identify this child mechanically; game meaning remains open.

units.name: SpawnFourDirectionalChildren
units.summary: Attempt four type-nine child allocations at the source actor position. Give each a different frame/direction index, fixed sprite and initial status; the following handler services camera/contact/player-state checks and child velocity/mode updates.

units.name: ActorDirectionalChildUpdate
units.summary: Reject off-camera/terminal children, otherwise run the directional velocity and mode handlers before joining the existing integration/render continuation. Global/player inhibition preserves the shared render path.

units.name: ActorDirectionalChildFinish
units.summary: Shared render/reward/removal tails precede a related update that alternates display-facing by frame-clock bit three and dispatches its motion mode.

units.name: ActorFlashingChildUpdate
units.summary: Check camera/contact/player state, alternate its facing display bit from the frame clock and dispatch the two motion modes.

units.name: ActorFlashingChildFinishAndDispatch
units.summary: Render the child; the later entry dispatches the low motion bit through exactly two pointer words.

units.name: ActorFlashingChildDispatchMode
units.summary: Mask the low motion bit and double it to choose one of two child-motion handlers.

units.name: ActorDirectionalChildLoadVelocity
units.summary: Clear status bit three and use the frame/direction index to load a four-byte X/Y velocity record.

units.name: ActorChildLoadHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Derive a two-word horizontal velocity selection from motion flags and store both velocity bytes.

units.name: ActorChildDispatchVerticalMode
units.summary: Use the low motion bit as an exact two-word selector for falling versus bounce initialization.

units.name: ActorChildFallUntilTerrain
units.summary: Apply capped gravity. Once descending, sample terrain; increment the mode when the terrain test is negative, enabling the bounce initializer on the next dispatch.

units.name: ActorChildGravityReturn
units.summary: Common return precedes the gravity helper, which adds $0040 to vertical velocity and caps nonnegative descent at $0300.

units.name: ActorChildApplyGravity
units.summary: Accelerate vertically by $0040 per tick; preserve upward velocity and cap downward velocity at $0300.

units.name: ActorChildStartBounce
units.summary: Set vertical velocity to $FB00 and advance the motion mode.

units.name: EmitAlternatingRotatingEffects
units.summary: Use frame parity to choose two starting angles and attempt two type-seven allocations. New effects rise first, then change to periodic rotating velocity while their finite lifetime counts down.

units.name: SpawnRisingRotatingEffect
units.summary: Allocate type seven with the scratch angle, a sixteen-step lifetime and initial $FB00 vertical velocity. Preserve allocation failure without writing a destination.

units.name: ActorRisingRotatingEffectUpdate
units.summary: Reject off-camera or expired effects. Otherwise increment the timer, run rise/rotation motion, integrate and animate before rendering. Global/player inhibition keeps the shared render path.

units.name: ActorRisingRotatingEffectMotion
units.summary: During ascent apply gravity; at the apex clear vertical velocity and mark the rotating phase. Every eighth tick decrement lifetime, advance the angle modulo 32 and set directional velocity.

units.name: ActorRisingRotatingEffectSelectSprite
units.summary: Alternate the effect's two sprite pointers using timer bit three.

units.name: EmitPairedDirectionActors
units.summary: Emit two type-five actors with alternating direction pairs determined by the source animation-frame parity. Each child starts sixteen pixels above its source and saves that Y origin in its extension fields.

units.name: SpawnPairedDirectionActor
units.summary: Check a free slot and initialize type five, fixed display/frame fields and saved vertical origin. The caller writes the child motion direction after this helper returns.

units.name: ActorPairedDirectionUpdate
units.summary: Service camera/contact/terrain checks, animate display flags and dispatch its vertical motion mode; terminal contact awards reward and removes the actor.

units.name: ActorPairedDirectionFinish
units.summary: Shared render/reward/removal tails precede its timed display and motion-dispatch helpers.

units.name: ActorPairedDirectionAnimate
units.summary: Increment the timer and combine its flashing bits with the actor display flags, preserving active and low attribute bits.

units.name: ActorPairedDirectionDispatchMotion
units.summary: Convert the supported motion-direction bit into offsets zero or two and dispatch the two vertical-motion handlers.

units.name: ActorPairedDirectionStartRise
units.summary: Set $FB00 vertical velocity and mark motion bit seven. The later helper applies $0040 gravity and caps descent at $0300.

units.name: ActorPairedDirectionApplyGravity
units.summary: Add $0040 to vertical velocity, preserving upward movement and limiting nonnegative descent to $0300.

units.name: SpawnOffsetType11Actor
units.summary: Create type $0B, copy facing/direction configuration and save its original Y before placing it 32 pixels higher. The caller supplies an available destination slot.

units.name: ActorSetFastUpwardVelocity
units.summary: Set the vertical high byte to $F8 and return; the low byte is supplied by the existing caller path.

units.name: ActorFinishCappedGravity
units.summary: Complete the preceding low-byte gravity addition, propagate carry and cap nonnegative vertical velocity at $0300.

units.name: ActorSubstateInitializeDisplay
units.summary: On the accepted comparison result initialize actor display/direction, upward-motion mode, timer and type-dependent subpalette. Then select its sprite and complete the common actor initialization.

units.name: ActorSubstateJoinActivePath
units.summary: Rejoin the already reviewed active-state path without changing actor fields.

units.name: ActorSubstateAlternateReactionTail
units.summary: Tail-call the alternate reaction conversion path; this continuation does not initialize another state locally.

units.name: ActorAdvanceSubstate
units.summary: Advance the actor's substate and fall into the existing state continuation.

units.name: ActorSubstateLandingAndAttack
units.summary: If descending onto supported terrain, stop motion, align Y and advance a two-frame landing animation. Later substates alternate waiting, proximity/random-gated emission and timed three-step recovery, changing substate/animation flags at independently visible boundaries.

units.name: ActorSubstateTimedEmission
units.summary: Count down the wait and track a proximity mode. At sixteen-frame intervals advance a three-step sequence, attempt a type-three effect when enabled, then move to the next substate after its repeat count expires.

units.name: ActorSubstateResetAfterRecovery
units.summary: Advance the three-step recovery at sixteen-frame intervals; restore player-facing direction, rise mode, initial timer and substate one when the sequence completes.

units.name: ActorAlignYToEightPixels
units.summary: Round the actor's low Y coordinate down to the eight-pixel boundary; preserve its high byte.

units.name: ActorReverseFacingOnContact
units.summary: Toggle the low direction bit, start contact flash and apply accumulated damage before entering the existing recovery continuation.

units.name: ActorFinishContactRecovery
units.summary: After the flash completes restore display/status. If a substate is active and the frame index is zero, reset timer and move to substate two.

units.name: PickupActorInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Before activation, service camera/contact state and display a fixed sprite. Once its frame sequence completes, switch to pickup motion and select a pickup kind. Active pickup paths test player bounds, apply the kind-specific effect, move/animate and render; collection or terminal rejection removes the actor.

units.name: PickupSelectKind
units.summary: Use the actor's configured kind when nonnegative. Otherwise choose among bounded kind candidates using shared selection history, lives/resource conditions and a random-indexed eight-byte row; store the result in the actor direction/kind field.

units.name: PickupDispatchEffect
units.summary: Double the pickup kind and jump through its seven-word handler slice. The caller must supply a supported kind zero through six; unchecked values do not establish further table extent.

units.name: PickupRestorePrimaryMeter
units.summary: Kind zero restores the primary meter to its configured maximum and requests sound $13. A second entry adds three with a clamp; another raises the player configuration toward a level-dependent cap.

units.name: PickupAddPrimaryMeter
units.summary: Add three to the primary meter, clamp to its configured maximum and request sound $14.

units.name: PickupRaisePlayerConfiguration
