units.summary: Raise the player configuration byte by four up to the level-selector-indexed limit, then request sound $15.

units.name: PickupAdvancePlayerAnimationConfig
units.summary: Advance the player timing/configuration index with a cap at three, request sound $16 and join the initial player animation timing setup. Subsequent entries raise progression, add a packed-decimal life or enter the display transition.

units.name: PickupRaiseProgression
units.summary: Increment the progression byte with a cap of two and request sound $16.

units.name: PickupAddLife
units.summary: Add one packed-decimal life unless already $99; request sound $1C. The following transition entry calls the shared display-save/scene path.

units.name: PickupApplyMotion
units.summary: Ordinary pickup kinds use capped gravity and stop/align on terrain. Kind six rises until the apex, then clears a status bit and periodically advances a 32-direction velocity sequence. The later sprite helper chooses a fixed per-kind record or a timer-alternating special sprite.

units.name: PickupSelectSprite
units.summary: Choose the three-byte sprite/display record by pickup kind. Kind six uses a two-frame timed sprite and different fixed display attributes.

units.name: ActorHoldUpInteraction
units.summary: Compare the player bounds with the actor extension record. While overlapping and Up remains held, count to $40 ticks; then combine the actor-kind-selected action with bit seven into the shared action byte and reset the timer. Rejected overlaps or missing input return without triggering the action.

units.name: ActorProximityEmitterUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display once within the player-distance gate. Normal updates service contact flash, run a three-phase emission/cooldown timer and choose its two-frame sprite; the emission phase also requires the actor random mask to clear. Shared tails render, remove or convert the actor.

units.name: ActorProximityEmitterReaction
units.summary: Start flash and apply contact damage when reaction bit six is set; restore display/status when the timer completes.

units.name: ActorProximityEmitterCycle
units.summary: When idle and the random/proximity gates pass, emit a rotating pair, set the first phase and timer $10. Later phases use timer bit four to advance, cool down and reset motion/timer.

units.name: ActorProximityEmitterSelectSprite
units.summary: Use timer bit four to choose one of two sprite pointers.

units.name: ActorCountedEmitterUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display and increment the shared actor count once. Normal updates service contact state, movement trigger, horizontal velocity, integration and finite emission animation. All removal/conversion tails decrement the shared count, preventing a leaked active-instance count.

units.name: ActorCountedEmitterReaction
units.summary: Run the shared status-controlled flash/damage sequence and restore display flags after recovery.

units.name: ActorCountedEmitterCheckTrigger
units.summary: When not in the active emission phase, compare the random byte with the actor mask and set motion bit seven on equality, resetting motion counters.

units.name: ActorCountedEmitterHorizontalMotion
units.summary: While not emitting, decrement a phase counter and toggle horizontal direction every 32 steps, then load the signed two-byte velocity. Emission state leaves that velocity unchanged here.

units.name: ActorCountedEmitterAnimate
units.summary: Every sixteen ticks load a frame record and alternate display facing while idle. During emission face toward the player, progress a finite frame sequence, emit a child at frame eight and reset state at frame eleven.

units.name: ActorCountedEmitterLoadFrame
units.summary: Mask the frame to four bits and load its four-byte sprite/attribute/variant record. The variant byte also controls the emission-facing adjustment.

units.name: ActorFamily38InitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Require the level-mode gate and no competing active type before initializing this family. Select a type-dependent subpalette, then service collision, contact, movement and animation with the usual global/player inhibition. Terminal state deactivates the actor and selects alternate reaction conversion.

units.name: ActorFamily38ReverseAtEdges
units.summary: While in moving mode, detect the low-X screen edges and replace direction from the player relation while preserving the mode bits.

units.name: ActorFamily38ChooseAttackMode
units.summary: Reset animation and choose a proximity-gated attack flag, preserving the low motion bits. The fallback chooses the alternate action mode.

units.name: ActorFamily38ContactReaction
units.summary: On contact choose the reaction motion mode, start flashing and apply accumulated damage. At completion clear the extra mode bit and restore display/status.

units.name: ActorFamily38TerrainMotion
units.summary: Check the sampled terrain, refresh edge-facing state and horizontal motion counters, then load the direction-indexed horizontal velocity only while moving.

units.name: ActorFamily38Animate
units.summary: Face the display toward the player. Moving mode alternates two idle frames; attack/recovery modes advance at eight-tick intervals through finite frame groups and return to movement. One attack phase emits the rotating-effect pair.

units.name: ActorFamily38LoadFrame
units.summary: Add the supplied animation-group base to the low frame nibble and load the four-byte sprite/attribute/work record.

units.name: ActorFamily3AInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Initialize this type family only under the level-mode and competing-type conditions, using a type-specific subpalette. Normal updates service collision/contact, proximity-selected action, grounded velocity, camera-edge correction, finite animation and integration; terminal state uses alternate conversion.

units.name: ActorFamily3AChooseGroundAction
units.summary: When moving on supported terrain, advance selection counters and choose between ordinary movement and two attack flags using random-mask and nested player-distance checks. Reset animation when entering an action; otherwise replace facing from the player relation.

units.name: ActorFamily3AAdvanceChoiceCounter
units.summary: Increment the auxiliary counter and advance the variant on alternate calls, supplying the slow random-mask/action selector.

units.name: ActorFamily3AContactReaction
units.summary: Set reaction movement flags, start flash and apply contact damage. Clear the temporary reaction-direction bit and restore display/status once the flash finishes.

units.name: ActorFamily3AGroundedVelocity
units.summary: On supported terrain reset movement state and load horizontal velocity from low motion bits. At the horizontal limits either enter an attack mode or toggle direction; nonmoving states preserve the shared return path.

units.name: ActorFamily3AClampCameraPage
units.summary: When the actor leaves the camera's X page, place it at the appropriate low-X edge, update direction and page to match the camera and reset movement state.

units.name: ActorFamily3AAnimate
units.summary: Moving mode derives facing and alternates two frames. Action modes advance finite frame groups at sixteen-tick intervals; the five-frame group emits four camera-relative children before returning to motion.

units.name: ActorFamily3ALoadFrame
units.summary: Index the four-byte sprite/attribute/work records by the group base plus frame nibble. Return the fourth record byte in A for the caller's further use.

units.name: ActorFamily3CInitialize
units.summary: Require level mode and competing-type checks, initialize display/direction and load the type-$3C-based subpalette. Preserve the bounded family-type precondition for the indexed palette source.

units.name: ActorFamily3CUpdate
units.summary: Service collision/contact before the movement and animation state machines, then integrate and render. Player override uses the common recovery path; terminal status deactivates and converts the actor.

units.name: ActorFamily3CMotionState
units.summary: Start the initial phase, then handle rising/falling, terrain landing and timed horizontal approach states. Landing resets velocity/animation and selects facing; the later attack choice requires a free slot and a clear actor-mask comparison.

units.name: ActorFamily3CApproachVelocity
units.summary: Reset motion counters and choose signed horizontal velocity while inside the direction-dependent X window. Reaching its limit returns without installing further movement.

units.name: ActorFamily3CReaction
units.summary: Advance its auxiliary counter on contact, start flash and apply accumulated damage, then restore display/status when recovery finishes.

units.name: ActorFamily3CAnimate
units.summary: Use motion bits to select startup, airborne, walking and child-emission frame groups. Finite groups advance at sixteen-tick intervals; the emission group creates a type-$0B child and rejoins jump initialization.

units.name: ActorFamily3CStartJump
units.summary: Reset animation/motion counters, set motion flags $88 and install upward velocity $FC00.

units.name: ActorFamily3CLoadFrame
units.summary: Combine group base with the low three frame bits and load the four-byte sprite/attribute/work record.

units.name: ActorFiveStateInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Require level-mode and competing-type conditions, initialize display/subpalette once, then service contact, auxiliary counters and its bounded motion subdispatch. Rendering remains in the shared continuation.

units.name: ActorFiveStateRenderTail
units.summary: Render the current actor through the shared fixed-bank helper and return normally.

units.name: ActorFiveStateOverrideAndDispatch
units.summary: Player override invokes the common recovery helper. The subsequent contact helper performs status-controlled flash/damage handling; the dispatcher faces toward the player and selects a supported motion state from the low three bits.

units.name: ActorFiveStateContactReaction
units.summary: Run the status-controlled flash/damage sequence for the selected actor, preserving other state fields.

units.name: ActorFiveStateDispatch
units.summary: Set display-facing from the player relation and dispatch the low three motion bits. Only five entries are currently supported; values five through seven are not established by this slice.

units.name: ActorFiveStateIdle
units.summary: Mark the active state and play a three-frame idle group at 32-tick intervals. On completion choose the next motion state from an eight-byte random-indexed table, excluding the special action when player override/work state disallows it.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display/subpalette under the level/type gate. Normal updates service contact, offscreen repositioning, edge direction, attack selection, velocity, integration and animation. Terminal actors clear their shared flag and use alternate conversion; player override cancels temporary action bits/counters.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackCancelOverride
units.summary: Run the shared override reaction, clear temporary motion bits and reset the sequence counter.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackReverseAtEdges
units.summary: For the supported actor types, combine camera-relative Y and horizontal screen-edge tests with velocity direction. Toggle motion/display facing and reset animation when an edge reversal is required.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackLoadVelocity
units.summary: In ordinary motion select signed horizontal velocity from motion bits; reaction mode also installs vertical $FF80. Directional attack mode leaves velocity to its angular helper.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackSweep
units.summary: Every fourth frame advance or reverse the angle, derive velocity at magnitudes $0E/$0E and stop outside its supported angular window. One actor type emits four children on completion when in the interior X window and enabled by its configuration.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackChooseAttack
units.summary: Require ordinary motion, no contact/terminal bits and a clear random mask. Quantize the player-relative direction and enter the angular attack only inside the direction-dependent sector window; initialize angle and velocity together.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackPlayerSector
units.summary: Subtract actor coordinates from player bound coordinates, quantize the signed differences and return the halved sector in scratch for the action gate.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackReaction
units.summary: Set the temporary reaction mode, service flash/damage and restore display/status, then clear the temporary motion bit at completion.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackAnimate
units.summary: Ordinary motion cycles three frames at sixteen-tick intervals. Angular attack fixes frame three. Load the selected four-byte sprite/attribute/work record without changing motion.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackLoadFrame
units.summary: Load the current frame's four-byte sprite/attribute/work record; the fourth byte is shared scratch, not a persistent actor field.

units.name: ActorDirectionalAttackReposition
units.summary: If the actor is rejected by the camera-window helper, end its angular action and reinitialize it near a camera edge chosen from the player's low-X sign. Copy camera pages, derive facing and choose one of four camera-relative Y positions from random bits.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterInitialize
units.summary: Require camera and player-distance acceptance, increment the shared active count and initialize display, direction and motion mode. Existing status skips initialization through the later active path.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterStartAlternateMode
units.summary: Derive facing from the player relation and set the alternate motion flags; save the same flags in the extension phase byte.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterJoinActiveTail
units.summary: Rejoin the shared active update tail without changing state.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterReactionAndProbeTail
units.summary: Tail-call the shared reaction conversion; the following entry builds the zero-index probe template and invokes alternate collision/motion handling.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterBuildProbe
units.summary: Build probe template zero and tail-call the alternate collision/movement helper.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterApplyDamage
units.summary: Apply accumulated contact damage before the existing flash-timer continuation.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterFinishFlash
units.summary: When the preceding timer is zero restore direction/display and clear temporary reaction bits; otherwise preserve the existing timer continuation.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterTerrainMode
units.summary: On the supported terrain result clear active mode bits, set motion bit six and reset animation. Other terrain results retain the shared motion continuation.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterFinishFourFrames
units.summary: Advance at eight-tick intervals. On frame four reset animation, select the next action bits and install fast upward velocity $F800.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterLandingChoice
units.summary: On terrain stop vertical velocity, face the player and reset animation. Choose a nearby child-emission mode or random-gated alternate motion from proximity and actor mask conditions; clear the phase byte when entering the first mode.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterSpawnOrFall
units.summary: Attempt the supported child allocation and enter its matching motion flags. A later falling-state check clamps the actor at the lower Y boundary, while the alternate path emits a child only under the phase/proximity/random conditions.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterStartJump
units.summary: Install upward velocity $FC00 and reset animation through the shared helper.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterFinishGravity
units.summary: Propagate the preceding low-byte acceleration carry into the vertical high byte and cap nonnegative descent at $0300.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterThreeFrameAction
units.summary: Advance action frames every sixteen ticks. On frame three reset animation and replace action bits with $11 while preserving unrelated motion flags.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterTwoFrameAction
units.summary: Advance at sixteen-tick intervals and join the common action completion after frame two.

units.name: ActorLeapingEmitterRepeatFrames
units.summary: Advance every eight ticks and loop frames five/six while a variant repeat count remains. On exhaustion reset animation, derive facing and select the next motion flags using the saved phase byte.

units.name: LinkedActorInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Save this actor slot in the shared link byte and initialize display/subpalette once. Active updates are gated by linked-control flags and player state; service contact, a slow choice counter and the six-entry supported motion subdispatch before rendering.

units.name: LinkedActorRenderTail
units.summary: Render the linked actor through the shared fixed-bank helper and return.

units.name: LinkedActorOverrideAndReaction
units.summary: Player override uses common recovery and rendering. The following helper performs status-controlled flash/damage handling and restores display/status on completion.

units.name: LinkedActorContactReaction
units.summary: Run linked-actor flash/contact-damage state, preserving its independent shared-link control flags.

units.name: LinkedActorFacePlayerWhenEnabled
units.summary: Only when linked-control bit zero is set, derive display-facing from the player relation. Otherwise leave display flags unchanged.

units.name: LinkedActorDispatchMode
units.summary: Use the low three motion bits to dispatch the supported six-word pointer slice. Modes six and seven are not established by these entries.

units.name: LinkedActorWaitForStageAdvance
units.summary: Play the base frame and set temporary status bits. When the player passes the supported X-page/low-X threshold, clear those bits, advance StageIndex, clear player override and enter main state $2A through the stack-reset transition. The next state waits 32 ticks, sets linked-control bit zero and selects a random choice.

units.name: LinkedActorWaitAndChoose
units.summary: Face the player when enabled and advance a 32-tick wait. At completion set linked-control bit zero, reset animation, choose motion state two and load a bounded random choice into its phase byte.

units.name: LinkedActorPositionForAction
units.summary: Select an initial X page, then optionally place the actor on the player's near side using the shared action code. Otherwise use player/camera position, facing and the phase byte to choose an offset; reset animation and advance motion state when placement is ready.

units.name: LinkedActorChooseNextAction
units.summary: Face the player, mark the active animation group and wait 32 ticks. Then select a bounded random action, suppressing the special action under incompatible player/work states; proximity can substitute another action.

units.name: LinkedActorProximityActionTail
units.summary: Apply the player-distance gate before selecting the nearby action; the next finite action advances five frames at sixteen-tick intervals then returns to motion state one.

units.name: LinkedActorFiveFrameAction
units.summary: Play the selected action group and advance every sixteen ticks. After frame five reset animation and return to motion state one.

units.name: LinkedActorSharedAction
units.summary: Play the special action group. On its first frame set linked-control bit one and wait for the linked record's bit-seven response; then clear/consume control state, choose the shared player action and save the source actor position. Later timed frames return to state one.

units.name: LinkedActorAdvanceChoiceCounter
units.summary: Increment variant each call and increment the phase byte on alternate variants, providing a slower action-choice sequence.

units.name: LinkedActorLoadFrame
units.summary: Add the animation-group base to the low frame nibble and load the four-byte sprite/attribute/work record.

units.name: LinkedCompanionFollowAndSignal
units.summary: Wait for linked control, then initialize this companion at the source slot's position plus twelve X pixels and install its palette/sprite. While the shared action bit is set, follow the source at a facing-dependent X offset and Y-$28. Count down the frame field, set control bit seven on completion and alternate the companion sprite while rendering.

units.name: ActorFiveStateFiniteActions
units.summary: Play the attack frame groups at sixteen-tick intervals, emitting the aimed child at a designated frame. Another group sets shared player action $82 only when player override permits it. Reverse animation then advances to an offscreen delay state; on expiry select one of four camera-relative X offsets and return to idle.

units.name: ActorFiveStateSharedPlayerAction
units.summary: Play the special action group, wait until frame four to request shared player action $82 and finish after frame five or the shared response permits recovery.

units.name: ActorFiveStateReverseAnimation
units.summary: Mark the reverse-animation phase, decrement its frames every 32 ticks and, after underflow, reset animation and enter the delayed reposition state with phase $B0.

units.name: ActorFiveStateDelayedReposition
units.summary: Hold the actor offscreen until its phase byte reaches zero, then choose a bounded random X offset relative to the camera and return motion state zero.

units.name: ActorFiveStateAdvanceChoice
units.summary: Increment variant every call and advance the phase byte on alternate calls, feeding the action/reposition timing.

units.name: ActorFiveStateLoadFrame
units.summary: Combine animation group with the low frame nibble and load its four-byte sprite/attribute/work record.

units.name: ActorSharedActionInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Require level mode, a free shared actor flag and no competing type before initialization. Increment the shared active flag, install display/subpalette and service contact, slow counters and supported motion subdispatch under global/player-state gates.

units.name: ActorSharedActionRenderTail
units.summary: Render the current actor and return normally.

units.name: ActorSharedActionOverrideAndDispatch
units.summary: Player override joins common recovery/rendering. The later helpers service contact flash/damage, face toward the player and dispatch the low three motion bits through only five supported entries.

units.name: ActorSharedActionContactReaction
units.summary: Run the status-controlled flash/damage sequence and restore display/status when the timer completes.

units.name: ActorSharedActionDispatchMode
units.summary: Face toward the player and dispatch the supported five-state motion slice. Masking to three bits alone does not establish modes five through seven.

units.name: ActorSharedActionChooseNext
units.summary: Advance a three-frame idle group every eight ticks. Then choose a bounded random action, substituting another mode when player override/shared action makes the special choice unsuitable; an existing shared action can force the finite-action entry directly.

units.name: ActorSharedActionProximityTail
units.summary: Test the player-distance threshold before choosing the nearby action. The following finite action advances five frames before selecting its recovery state and frame two.

units.name: ActorSharedActionFiveFrameAttack
units.summary: Advance the attack group every sixteen ticks; after frame five reset animation, enter recovery mode three and start at frame two.

units.name: ActorSharedActionRequestPlayerAction
units.summary: Play the shared action animation at 32-tick intervals. At frame four choose a bounded action from random bit one, set the shared action flags and save the actor X/Y into the action parameter record. Wait for the response before returning to ordinary motion.

units.name: ActorSharedActionReverseAnimation
units.summary: Reverse the base animation every eight ticks. On underflow reset animation and enter delayed reposition mode with phase $B0.

units.name: ActorSharedActionReposition
units.summary: Initially hold the actor offscreen. A matching shared action places it beside the player; otherwise wait for the phase byte to expire and choose a bounded camera-relative X offset. Then return to motion state zero.

units.name: ActorSharedActionAdvanceChoice
units.summary: Advance the variant and increment its phase byte on alternate calls.

units.name: ActorSharedActionLoadFrame
units.summary: Load the four-byte sprite/attribute/work record from animation group plus the low frame nibble.

units.name: PairedActorInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Require level-mode/type gates and a free actor slot. Save the source slot, initialize its display/subpalette and allocate a type-$41 companion whose slot is retained separately. Normal updates service contact, edge state, velocity, integration and animation; terminal state signals the linked companion through the shared control flags.

units.name: PairedActorContactReaction
units.summary: Set the temporary reaction mode, service flash/contact damage, then clear that mode and restore display/status after recovery.

units.name: PairedActorCheckEdges
units.summary: Run the ordinary edge-reversal helper only while shared linked-control bit seven is clear.

units.name: PairedActorHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Reset motion counters, then when movement is enabled load horizontal velocity from the supported direction/reaction bits. Other motion states retain the common return path.

units.name: PairedActorSelectSprite
units.summary: Unless linked-control bit seven freezes it, advance the timer and choose between two four-byte sprite records; the frozen path uses record offset eight.

units.name: PairedCompanionInitializeOrUpdate
units.summary: Initialize the companion at a camera-relative location with default motion. Then run linked contact/motion logic, integration and sprite selection; terminal state signals the source actor when allowed by the shared control flag.

units.name: PairedActorsEnterReturnMode
units.summary: Restore display direction, retain only the direction motion bit, set terminal/reaction status and set shared linked-control bit seven, causing the pair to enter the return/recombination path.

units.name: PairedActorsMoveOrReturn
units.summary: While control bit seven is clear use the ordinary contact, edge, attack and velocity helpers. Otherwise aim at the saved source position minus 32 Y pixels, integrate directional motion and compare both coordinate differences against four. Once close, clear linked control, restore type from the source configuration and deactivate the source slot.

units.name: PairedActorsHorizontalDifference
units.summary: Subtract current actor X from the saved source-slot X and copy the signed difference into comparison/angle scratch.

units.name: PairedActorsVerticalDifference
units.summary: Subtract current actor Y from the saved source Y minus 32 pixels; retain the signed difference for comparison and direction quantization.

units.name: PairedCompanionSelectSprite
units.summary: Choose a four-byte sprite/attribute/work record from timer bit three unless linked control or attack motion freezes the animation at record offset eight.

units.name: PairedAlternateCompanionUpdate
units.summary: Initialize its status, damage accumulator, direction and motion once, then run the same linked movement and integration contract. Terminal state deactivates and converts the actor; player override cancels temporary action mode.

units.name: PairedAlternateCompanionSelectSprite
units.summary: Use timer bit three for two ordinary four-byte records or offset eight in attack mode; copy the record and install the extra work constant $3C.

units.name: SceneLoadPaletteSelection
units.summary: Add the palette-page origin to A and load the selected background palette, then install subpalette selector seven. A is a byte offset, not a palette index scaled here.

units.name: SceneIntegrateAndRenderObject0
units.summary: Point CurrentObject at scene record $0496, integrate its velocity and render. Three following entries perform the same operation for records $04A6, $04B6 and $04C6.

units.name: SceneIntegrateAndRenderObject1
units.summary: Integrate and render the second scene object at $04A6.

units.name: SceneIntegrateAndRenderObject2
units.summary: Integrate and render the third scene object at $04B6.

units.name: SceneIntegrateAndRenderObject3
units.summary: Integrate and render the fourth scene object at $04C6.

units.name: IntroWaitTextOne
units.summary: Start text sequence one when its scene gate permits. Animate the accompanying transfer/object helper while waiting for text completion, then advance SceneStep and set the next signed gate value.

units.name: IntroWaitTextTwo
units.summary: When permitted, install the next palette/display page and start text two. Service its periodic tile animation until text completes, then advance the step and scene gate.

units.name: IntroWaitTextThree
units.summary: Select nametable zero and text three once the signed scene gate clears. Advance step/gate only after text completion.

units.name: IntroScrollToNextPage
units.summary: Increment main scroll, deriving nametable carry. At scroll $A0 load the next palette/display page and advance the step.

units.name: IntroScrollAndWaitTextFour
units.summary: Continue the page scroll until nametable carry, then start/wait for text four. Completion advances the scene gate and step.

units.name: IntroInstallFollowingPage
units.summary: When its scene gate clears, install the next palette/display page, reset nametable and advance the step/gate.

units.name: IntroStartTextFive
units.summary: Wait for the signed gate, start text five and advance to the following object-motion step.

units.name: IntroAnimateTextObjects
units.summary: Run the scene-object animation helper before the existing step continuation.

units.name: IntroCompleteTextAndStartSeven
units.summary: After text completion load the selected panel, choose nametable one, start text seven and advance SceneStep.

units.name: IntroTerminalFlashAndTransition
units.summary: Initialize the terminal object pose while its countdown is inactive. On text completion save the background palette and silence audio, then alternate saved palette/subpalettes until countdown expiry and enter main state zero. No SceneStep increment is required by this terminal handler.

units.name: IntroStartTerminalFlash
units.summary: Request sound $11 and initialize the signed $C0 countdown for the terminal flashing phase. Return-bank correctness relies on the previously established main-pair shadow contract.

units.name: IntroAdvanceTerminalFlash
units.summary: Decrement the terminal countdown. Alternate between subpalette loads and the saved background palette by parity; when low seven bits reach zero tail-call the stack-reset main-state transition.

units.name: IntroPeriodicTextTileAnimation
units.summary: While text is active and every sixteenth frame, queue a fixed transfer at PPU $2590. A paused/completed text state suppresses this animation.

units.name: IntroInitializeMovingObjects
units.summary: Initialize the first two scene objects once, with fixed display, position and velocity fields. Then service the paired animation helper before the existing integration/render continuation.

units.name: IntroRenderPairedObjects
units.summary: Integrate/render the first scene object, copy its X coordinate into the second and integrate/render that second record.

units.name: IntroAnimateObjectsAroundText
units.summary: Before the terminal phase, wait for text completion and start audio selection $11. The later continuation freezes velocity and enters the finite ending-frame group; otherwise frame-clock bits select ordinary paired sprites.

units.name: IntroBeginObjectFinalFrames
units.summary: Mark the object-animation terminal phase, stop its velocity and initialize the final frame counter.

units.name: IntroSelectOrdinaryObjectFrame
units.summary: Derive the ordinary paired-sprite table offset from frame-clock bits five/six.

units.name: IntroLoadPairedObjectSprites
units.summary: Use X as an even offset into two parallel sprite-pointer tables and install both object sprite pointers.

units.name: IntroAdvanceFinalObjectFrames
units.summary: If not already complete, advance the final object counter every sixteen frames. Clamp the table offset at ten and mark completion when the finite sequence ends.

units.name: IntroInstallTerminalObjectPose
units.summary: Install the final paired-object display/position fields, select the fixed terminal sprite pair and render both records.

units.name: SceneFamilyAInitializeAudio
units.summary: Prepare the scene through shared setup helpers and start audio selection three. The audio wrapper restores mapping through MainPrgPair, which must match this caller's effective pair 2/3.

units.name: SceneFamilyAInstallInitialPage
units.summary: Install palette/display page and signed scene gate, initialize display shadows, load a panel and two subpalettes, then dispatch the first scene step.

units.name: SceneFamilyADispatch
units.summary: Index the eleven-word bounded scene handler slice by twice SceneStep and jump through scratch. Effective PRG pair 2/3 is required; unrestricted SceneStep values are not established.

units.name: SceneFamilyAScrollFirstPage
units.summary: Scroll main X and derive nametable carry. Once the signed scene gate clears and carry selects the next page, update the gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyAWaitTextEight
units.summary: Start/wait for text eight. On completion change palette/display shadows and nametable, install the next signed gate and advance the step.

units.name: SceneFamilyAWaitTextNine
units.summary: Start text nine, service its periodic transfer animation and wait for completion; then load the next page/palette and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyAWaitTextTen
units.summary: Start text ten and run the multiobject helper. On completion hide sprites, restore the shared display page and advance the step.

units.name: SceneFamilyAWaitTextEleven
units.summary: Start text eleven, service the periodic transfer helper and, on completion, load the next page and start the auxiliary countdown before advancing.

units.name: SceneFamilyAWaitTextTwelve
units.summary: Wait for the auxiliary countdown, start text twelve and run the object helper. On completion hide sprites, reset nametable, advance step and initialize the $C0 flash countdown/sound.

units.name: SceneFamilyAFlashBackground
units.summary: Wait for the scene gate, then alternate the first color of each background subpalette between $30 and $0F. On countdown completion restore the next display page/gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyAWaitTextThirteen
units.summary: After its signed gate clears, start/wait for text thirteen. Completion changes palette/display page and nametable and advances the scene.

units.name: SceneFamilyAWaitTextFourteen
units.summary: Start/wait for text fourteen; completion loads a panel, selects the next page and signed gate, resets object state and advances SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyAWaitObjectAnimation
units.summary: After the scene gate clears run a finite object animation. When its completion flag becomes negative, hide sprites, install the next page and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyATerminalTextFifteen
units.summary: Start text fifteen and service its transfer animation. On completion enter main state three through ChangeMainState; the terminal handler does not advance to another local table entry.

units.name: SceneFamilyAPeriodicTransfer
units.summary: Use the caller's even table offset to load a PPU destination. Every fourth frame choose an animation source from frame-clock bits, overriding it when text is paused/completed, then enqueue the transfer.

units.name: SceneFamilyATwoFrameTransfer
units.summary: Load a destination from the caller's table index. Every fourth frame alternate two transfer sources; text flags select a fixed fallback source instead.

units.name: SceneFamilyAFiniteObjectAnimation
units.summary: Initialize the scene object once, then advance its sprite counter every fourth frame. After the finite frame range, wait for its counter's bit-four phase and mark completion; integrate/render each selected sprite.

units.name: SceneFamilyBPeriodicTransfer
units.summary: Load the caller-selected PPU destination and alternate two transfer sources every fourth frame, with a fixed fallback while text is paused/completed.

units.name: SceneFamilyBInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared scene setup and start audio selection six. Restoration from the audio wrapper requires MainPrgPair to match effective pair 2/3.

units.name: SceneFamilyBInstallInitialPage
units.summary: Install palette/display page, signed scene gate and display shadows, then invoke the scene-step dispatcher.

units.name: SceneFamilyBChooseNextMainState
units.summary: Choose main state three or $30 from global-state bit five, then enter ChangeMainState. This tail resets the stack and does not return to the scene loop.

units.name: SceneFamilyBDispatch
units.summary: Index the eight-word bounded scene handler slice by twice SceneStep. Only the supported step slice is established, under effective PRG pair 2/3.

units.name: SceneFamilyBScrollBack
units.summary: Wait for the signed scene gate, then decrement the two-byte scene scroll and copy it to main scroll/nametable. At low-byte zero install the next gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyBWaitText10
units.summary: After the signed gate clears, start/wait for text $10. Completion selects nametable zero and advances the step.

units.name: SceneFamilyBWaitText11
units.summary: When the signed gate permits, initialize three scene objects, start text $11 and load a panel. On completion hide sprites, switch page/gate and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyBWaitText12
units.summary: Wait for the signed gate and text $12 completion, then change palette/display page, nametable and gate before advancing.

units.name: SceneFamilyBWaitText13
units.summary: Start/wait for text $13 after the gate, service the animated overlay pair and on completion hide sprites, change page/palette and start an auxiliary countdown.

units.name: SceneFamilyBWaitAuxiliaryCountdown
units.summary: Wait until the auxiliary countdown reaches zero, install the next signed gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyBWaitText14
units.summary: After the gate start/wait for text $14; on completion hide sprites, select nametable zero and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyBTerminalText15
units.summary: Start/wait for text $15, then enter the global-state-dependent main-state transition. This terminal handler does not increment SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyBRenderThreeObjects
units.summary: Install three fixed scene-object display/sprite/position records and integrate/render each through the existing object helpers. These records share scene workspace, not the gameplay actor pool.

units.name: SceneFamilyBTwoFrameTransfer
units.summary: Load a caller-selected PPU destination and, every fourth frame, alternate between two transfer sources. Text pause/completion flags choose a fixed fallback source.

units.name: SceneFamilyCInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared scene setup and start audio selection $0D. Return mapping requires MainPrgPair to match the caller effective pair 2/3.

units.name: SceneFamilyCInstallInitialPanel
units.summary: Install its signed gate and display-shadow configuration, load the initial panel and dispatch the first supported scene step.

units.name: SceneFamilyCChooseNextMainState
units.summary: Choose main state three or $30 from global bit five, then enter the stack-reset ChangeMainState tail.

units.name: SceneFamilyCDispatch
units.summary: Double SceneStep and jump through the bounded eight-word pointer slice. Only the supported local step values and effective pair 2/3 are established.

units.name: SceneFamilyCWaitObjectDelay
units.summary: Render the first object pair while waiting for the signed scene gate and object countdown. On expiry change the display page and signed gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyCCycleBackgroundColors
units.summary: Render the object pair while advancing a six-step palette sequence every eighth frame. Copy two three-color groups into background palette RAM and request uploads; at completion reset the object counter, change palette and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyCWaitObjectAndChangePage
units.summary: Render the object pair and wait for the scene gate/countdown. Then hide sprites, change palette/page/gate, advance step and install the next fixed object pose.

units.name: SceneFamilyCWaitText16
units.summary: After the signed gate, start/wait for text $16. On completion queue a fixed transfer and advance; render the fixed object pose while waiting.

units.name: SceneFamilyCWaitText17
units.summary: Start/wait for text $17 under the scene gate. Advance after text completion while continuing the fixed object pose.

units.name: SceneFamilyCWaitText18
units.summary: Start/wait for text $18. On completion advance, set an $50-tick object countdown and hide sprites.

units.name: SceneFamilyCWaitPageDelay
units.summary: Decrement the object countdown. At zero install palette/display page and advance; always select nametable zero for this step.

units.name: SceneFamilyCTerminalText19
units.summary: Start/wait for text $19 and service its periodic PPU transfer. Completion enters the global-state-dependent terminal main-state transition.

units.name: SceneFamilyCQueueFixedTransfer
units.summary: Queue the fixed source transfer to PPU $250A; the shared queue helper reports full through carry.

units.name: SceneFamilyCAnimateObjectPair
units.summary: Initialize the first object once, then toggle its display-facing every sixteen frames while rendering it. Install and render a fixed companion object each call.

units.name: SceneFamilyCInstallObjectPose
units.summary: Install fixed object display/position, render the caller-selected sprite and then a second sprite pose through the common object renderer.

units.name: SceneFamilyDInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared scene setup and start audio selection eight, preserving the conditional MainPrgPair return contract.

units.name: SceneFamilyDInstallInitialPage
units.summary: Load palette/panel and display shadows, install its signed scene gate and invoke the six-step local dispatcher.

units.name: SceneFamilyDChooseNextMainState
units.summary: Choose main state three or $30 according to global bit five and enter the stack-reset transition.

units.name: SceneFamilyDDispatch
units.summary: Use twice SceneStep to jump through the six-word supported scene pointer slice under effective pair 2/3.

units.name: SceneFamilyDWaitText1A
units.summary: After its signed gate permits, start text $1A and render the fixed object group. On text completion hide sprites, select nametable zero, update the signed gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyDScrollForward
units.summary: Wait for the signed gate, then increment main scroll until nametable carry. Install the next signed gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyDWaitText1B
units.summary: Start/wait for text $1B after its gate; completion changes palette/page/nametable, installs the next gate and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyDWaitText1C
units.summary: Start text $1C and service the shared animation helper. Completion changes palette/page/nametable, renders the three-object pose and advances the gate/step.

units.name: SceneFamilyDWaitText1D
units.summary: Start text $1D under its gate while rendering the three-object pose. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyDTerminalText1E
units.summary: Start/wait for text $1E, rendering the alternate overlay pair. Completion enters the global-state-dependent main-state transition.

units.name: SceneFamilyEInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared scene setup and start audio selection seven; the audio wrapper restores mapping from the caller main-pair shadow.

units.name: SceneFamilyEInstallInitialPage
units.summary: Load panel and subpalettes, initialize display shadows, page and signed scene gate, then enter the five-step dispatcher.

units.name: SceneFamilyEChooseNextMainState
units.summary: Choose main state three or $30 from global bit five and tail-call ChangeMainState.

units.name: SceneFamilyEDispatch
units.summary: Double SceneStep and jump through the bounded five-word handler slice. Unsupported selector values remain outside the established contract.

units.name: SceneFamilyEInstallPaletteGate
units.summary: After its signed gate clears, select palette offset $3C, install the next gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyEWaitScrollCountdown
units.summary: After its signed gate, decrement the scene scroll countdown. At zero change palette/page/nametable, install the next gate and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyEWaitText1F
units.summary: Start text $1F under the gate and service periodic transfer/overlay animation. On completion fade the background to black, hide sprites, change palette/page/gate and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyEScrollWithObjectPairs
units.summary: Render both object pairs while the scene gate permits. Every fourth frame decrement the two-byte scene scroll and copy main scroll/nametable; at low-byte zero advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyETerminalText20
units.summary: Start/wait for text $20 after its gate, reserving the first seven OAM entries before rendering the overlay. Completion enters the global-state-dependent main-state transition.

units.name: SceneRenderVerticallyOffsetPair
units.summary: X supplies the two objects common X coordinate; Y supplies the lower object Y, with the first placed twenty pixels lower. Install fixed sprites/display bytes and integrate/render both records.

units.name: SceneRenderAnimatedOverlayPair
units.summary: Install two overlay objects at caller X/Y and choose their parallel sprite pointers from frame-clock bit four. Integrate/render both through the shared scene-object helpers.

units.name: SceneRenderAlternateOverlayPair
units.summary: Install the alternate overlay pair at caller X/Y, with complementary low display bits. Select parallel sprite pointers from frame-clock bit four and integrate/render both.

units.name: SceneFamilyFInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared scene setup and start audio selection $10. Return mapping depends on the main-pair shadow matching effective pair 2/3.

units.name: SceneFamilyFInstallInitialPage
units.summary: Load the panel, palette/display shadows, signed gate and initial nametable, then invoke its eight-step dispatcher.

units.name: SceneFamilyFChooseNextMainState
units.summary: Choose main state three or $30 from global bit five and enter the stack-reset transition.

units.name: SceneFamilyFDispatch
units.summary: Index the eight-word supported scene handler slice with twice SceneStep; maintain effective PRG pair 2/3.

units.name: SceneFamilyFSetFirstGate
units.summary: When permitted by the signed scene gate, choose nametable zero, install the next gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyFWaitText21
units.summary: Start/wait for text $21 under its gate and service periodic transfers. On completion change palette/display page, nametable and next gate, then advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyFWaitText22
units.summary: Start/wait for text $22 under its gate and service periodic transfers. On completion change palette/page, advance and start the auxiliary countdown.

units.name: SceneFamilyFWaitAuxiliaryCountdown
units.summary: Wait for the auxiliary countdown to clear, install the next signed gate and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyFWaitText23
units.summary: Start/wait for text $23 and service the shared animation helper. Completion changes palette/page/nametable, advances and installs the next gate.

units.name: SceneFamilyFWaitText24
units.summary: Start/wait for text $24, service periodic transfer animation, then change palette/display page and nametable, advance and install the next gate.

units.name: SceneFamilyFWaitText25
units.summary: Start/wait for text $25 with periodic transfers; completion changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyFTerminalText26
units.summary: Start/wait for text $26, servicing both periodic transfers and alternate overlay animation. Completion enters the global-state-dependent main-state transition.

units.name: SceneFamilyGInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared scene setup and start audio selection seven, retaining the conditional main-pair return contract.

units.name: SceneFamilyGInstallInitialGate
units.summary: Install the signed scene gate and invoke the six-step scene dispatcher.

units.name: SceneFamilyGChooseNextMainState
units.summary: Choose main state nine or $30 from global bit five and enter ChangeMainState through its stack-reset tail.

units.name: SceneFamilyGDispatch
units.summary: Double SceneStep and jump through the supported six-word pointer slice; unrestricted selector values are not proved.

units.name: SceneFamilyGInstallPage
units.summary: After its signed gate clears install palette/display page, update the next gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyGWaitText27
units.summary: Wait for text $27 under its signed gate. Completion changes palette/display page and nametable and advances SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyGWaitText28
units.summary: Start/wait for text $28 and service periodic transfers. Completion changes palette/page/nametable and next gate before advancing.

units.name: SceneFamilyGWaitText29
units.summary: Start/wait for text $29; completion changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyGWaitText2A
units.summary: Start/wait for text $2A with periodic transfers; completion changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyGTerminalText2B
units.summary: Start/wait for text $2B under its signed gate. Completion enters the main-state-nine/$30 terminal transition without incrementing the local step.

units.name: SceneFamilyHInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared scene setup and start audio selection seven, requiring the caller MainPrgPair shadow to match effective pair 2/3 on return.

units.name: SceneFamilyHInstallInitialPage
units.summary: Install panel, subpalettes and display shadows, set the signed scene gate and invoke the seventeen-step supported dispatcher.

units.name: SceneFamilyHChooseNextMainState
units.summary: Choose main state three or $30 from global bit five and enter the stack-reset ChangeMainState tail.

units.name: SceneFamilyHDispatch
units.summary: Double SceneStep and jump through the bounded seventeen-word handler slice. The accepted entries do not prove unrestricted step values safe.

units.name: SceneFamilyHInstallPalette
units.summary: Wait for the signed scene gate, install the palette/display page and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText2C
units.summary: Start/wait for text $2C, servicing periodic transfers. Completion requests sound $11, initializes a $40-tick flash and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyHFlashFirstPalette
units.summary: Decrement the flash countdown and alternate four background base colors between $30/$0F. At zero install two subpalettes, update the signed gate and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText2D
units.summary: Start/wait for text $2D under its gate and service periodic transfers. Completion changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText2E
units.summary: Start/wait for text $2E. Completion changes palette/page/nametable and signed gate, advances and selects audio eight; return mapping requires the main-pair shadow contract.

units.name: SceneFamilyHAudioContinuationReturn
units.summary: Return from the audio-selection continuation; restored mapping requires the caller main-pair shadow contract.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText2F
units.summary: Start/wait for text $2F with periodic transfers. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/page/nametable, advances and starts an auxiliary countdown.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitAuxiliaryGate
units.summary: Wait for the auxiliary countdown to clear, install the next signed gate and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText30
units.summary: Start/wait for text $30 with periodic transfers. Completion changes palette/page/nametable and starts another auxiliary countdown before advancing.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText31
units.summary: After the auxiliary countdown, start/wait for text $31 with periodic transfers. Completion selects the next nametable and restarts the countdown before advancing.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText32
units.summary: After the auxiliary countdown, start/wait for text $32 and render two object pairs, one using the alternate overlay entry. Completion hides sprites, sets the next gate and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyHInstallFollowingPalette
units.summary: After its signed gate clears, change palette/display page and nametable and advance.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText33
units.summary: After the auxiliary countdown, start/wait for text $33 with periodic transfer animation. Completion changes nametable, restarts the countdown and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText34
units.summary: Wait for auxiliary and signed gates, start/wait for text $34 and render object pairs. Completion requests sound $11, starts a $40-tick flash and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyHFlashSecondPalette
units.summary: Alternate four background base colors until the flash countdown expires. Then restore black palette state, hide sprites, render the fixed pair and update nametable/gate before advancing.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText35
units.summary: Start/wait for text $35. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/page/nametable and next signed gate, then advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyHWaitText36
units.summary: Start/wait for text $36 under its gate. Completion changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyHTerminalText37
units.summary: Start/wait for text $37 with periodic transfers. Completion enters the global-state-dependent main-state transition; no further local state is implied.

units.name: SceneFamilyIInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared scene setup and start audio selection one under the conditional main-pair restoration contract.

units.name: SceneFamilyIInstallInitialPage
units.summary: Load panel and display-shadow configuration, install the signed scene gate and invoke the seven-step supported dispatcher.

units.name: SceneFamilyIChooseNextMainState
units.summary: Choose main state six or $30 from global bit five, then tail-call the stack-reset transition.

units.name: SceneFamilyIDispatch
units.summary: Index the supported seven-word scene pointer slice with twice SceneStep under effective pair 2/3.

units.name: SceneFamilyIInstallObjectPage
units.summary: After the gate clears install palette/page/nametable and the fixed three-object pose. Set the next gate and advance SceneStep.

units.name: SceneFamilyIWaitText38
units.summary: Start/wait for text $38 while rendering the three-object pose. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyIWaitText39
units.summary: Start/wait for text $39 with periodic transfers. Completion changes palette/page/nametable, renders the fixed object group and advances with a new signed gate.

units.name: SceneFamilyIWaitText3A
units.summary: Start/wait for text $3A while rendering the fixed object group. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/page/nametable and advances with the next gate.

units.name: SceneFamilyIWaitText3B
units.summary: Start/wait for text $3B while servicing the shared animation helper. Completion changes palette/page/nametable and next signed gate before advancing.

units.name: SceneFamilyIWaitText3C
units.summary: Start/wait for text $3C under its gate. Completion changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: SceneFamilyITerminalText3D
units.summary: Start/wait for text $3D with periodic transfers. Completion enters main state six or $30 through the stack-reset transition.

units.name: EndingInitializeAudio
units.summary: Run shared setup and start audio selection eight. The wrapper restoration depends on MainPrgPair matching effective pair 2/3.

units.name: EndingInstallInitialPanel
units.summary: Set nametable one, load the panel and initialize signed gate plus four display-shadow bytes before the existing ending loop.

units.name: EndingInstallFirstPalette
units.summary: Wait for the signed gate, install palette/display page, advance the step and install the next gate.

units.name: EndingStartText3E
units.summary: Start ending text sequence $3E through the shared text initializer.

units.name: EndingChangePageAfterText3E
units.summary: On the preceding text-completion condition, change palette/page/nametable, advance the step and set the next signed gate.

units.name: EndingChangePageAfterText3F
units.summary: Complete the preceding palette change with display page/nametable, next scene step and signed gate.

units.name: EndingWaitText40
units.summary: Start/wait for text $40 under its gate and service periodic transfers. Completion changes palette/page/nametable, advances and sets the next gate.

units.name: EndingWaitText41
units.summary: Start text $41 after its signed gate while rendering the vertically offset pair. Completion selects nametable one, advances and installs the next gate.

units.name: EndingWaitText42
units.summary: Start/wait for text $42 with the fixed object pair. Completion requests sound $11, starts a $40-tick palette flash and advances.

units.name: EndingFlashAndSelectAudio
units.summary: Alternate four background base colors through the countdown. At zero hide sprites, change palette/page/nametable, advance/gate and start audio $12; return mapping depends on MainPrgPair.

units.name: EndingFlashAudioReturn
units.summary: Return after the ending flash starts audio selection $12; effective pair restoration remains conditional on MainPrgPair.

units.name: EndingSetFollowingDisplayPage
units.summary: Install display page $64 before falling into the previously reviewed ending continuation.

units.name: EndingWaitText44
units.summary: Start/wait for text $44 under its gate. Completion changes palette/page/nametable, advances the step and sets the next signed gate.

units.name: EndingWaitMovingPair
units.summary: Wait for the signed gate and update both moving-object helpers. Once their completion flag is negative hide sprites, change palette/page/nametable and advance.

units.name: EndingWaitText45
units.summary: Start/wait for text $45 with periodic transfer animation. Completion changes palette/page/nametable, advances/gates and enables the moving-pair final phase while rendering its related objects.

units.name: EndingWaitText46
units.summary: Start/wait for text $46 and render the moving pair plus fifth object. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/page/nametable and advances.

units.name: EndingWaitText47
units.summary: Start/wait for text $47 with periodic transfers. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/page/nametable/gate, advances and switches the fifth object mode before rendering the group.

units.name: EndingWaitText48
units.summary: Start/wait for text $48, reserve the first five OAM entries and render the fifth object. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/page/nametable/gate and advances.

units.name: EndingWaitText49
units.summary: Start/wait for text $49 while rendering an entering object. Completion hides sprites, changes palette/panel/page/gate and renders the terminal fourth-object pose before advancing.

units.name: EndingWaitText4A
units.summary: Start/wait for text $4A with periodic transfers and advance SceneStep only on text completion.

units.name: EndingWaitText4B
units.summary: After the gate, queue a fixed transfer, start text $4B and select audio $11. While waiting service periodic transfer animation; completion changes palette/panel/page, advances and renders the terminal scene-object poses.

units.name: EndingStartText4C
units.summary: Wait for the signed gate, then start ending text $4C through the shared text initializer.

units.name: EndingSelectTerminalAudio
units.summary: Select audio $0F before the next ending continuation. MainPrgPair must restore effective pair 2/3.

units.name: EndingAdvanceToTerminalStep
units.summary: Advance SceneStep after the audio wrapper and return to the ending loop.

units.name: EndingStartTerminalText4D
units.summary: Start terminal text $4D through the shared text initializer. The surrounding terminal handler does not advance beyond this bounded ending slice.

units.name: EndingAnimateMovingPair
units.summary: Initialize a moving scene-object pair once, render the first and copy its X into the second. Before reaching its horizontal threshold alternate ordinary sprite pairs from frame-clock bits. On threshold stop horizontal velocity and begin the finite final sequence; mark/pose completion after its frame limit.

units.name: EndingMovingPairSelectAnimation
units.summary: Detect the moving pair horizontal threshold, stop velocity and start final-frame counting. Otherwise select ordinary paired sprites from frame-clock bits; later entry handles final sequence completion.

units.name: EndingMovingPairFinalFrames
units.summary: When completion phase permits, advance final frames every sixteen ticks. Clamp to the terminal sprite pair and update display flags/completion bit once the finite sequence ends.

units.name: EndingAnimateFifthObject
units.summary: Point CurrentObject at scene record $04D6 and initialize its display/position once. The mode byte chooses velocity/work constants and a timer-alternating sprite; integrate/render the object every call.

units.name: EndingFifthObjectSelectVelocity
units.summary: Index the fifth scene object mode to load its work constant and two-byte horizontal velocity. The caller establishes the supported mode domain.

units.name: EndingFifthObjectSelectSprite
units.summary: Use mode zero for a fixed sprite; otherwise alternate the selected sprite pair from frame-clock bit four.

units.name: EndingInitializeEnteringObject
units.summary: Initialize the first scene object once at the right edge with negative horizontal velocity and a fixed sprite, then integrate/render it through the common helper.

units.name: EndingRenderTerminalObjectPose
units.summary: Install a fixed terminal pose for the third scene object, clear high coordinate bytes and render it.

units.name: EndingQueueFixedTransfer
units.summary: Queue a fixed source record at PPU $210B; queue-full status is returned by the shared helper.

units.name: EndingPeriodicTransferAtColumn
units.summary: Construct PPU destination $210E plus the caller-selected high-byte offset. Every fourth frame alternate two source records, with a fixed fallback when text is paused/completed.

units.name: EndingPeriodicTransferFromTable
units.summary: Load a caller-indexed destination and every fourth frame alternate two source records. Text flags choose the fixed fallback source.

units.name: EndingRenderFourthObjectPose
units.summary: Install a fixed terminal pose for scene object four and integrate/render it. Clear its high coordinate bytes; other record fields remain with the caller.

units.name: SpecialEncounterLoadTemplates
units.summary: Reverse-search six stage values and use the selected word to read an initialization template under effective pair 4/5. Its header supplies shared work bytes and a terminal input offset; successive four-byte X/Y/type records initialize $10-byte actor slots. Finally jump through the same-index six-word initializer table. The supported stage-match domain is required; no arbitrary selector range is implied.

units.name: SpecialEncounterBlackenPalette
units.summary: Under player override with secondary selection one, blacken the saved first eight palette colors. Always blacken the first eight active background colors and request upload. A later independent helper positions a selected part from the primary actor plus a signed four-byte offset record.

units.name: SpecialPartPositionFromPrimary
units.summary: Use the caller X part slot and Y four-byte offset record to add signed X/Y offsets to the primary actor position. The primary actor remains the fixed slot-zero source.

units.name: SpecialActorConvertToTimedEffect
units.summary: Award the actor-type packed reward, reset motion/animation and replace the actor with type $47. A five-byte conversion record supplies global flag mask, status, repeat count, frame attribute and sound. Related entries select the second/third conversion record.

units.name: SpecialActorConvertAlternateEffect
units.summary: Award the reward and select conversion record one before joining the common timed-effect setup.

units.name: SpecialActorConvertFinalEffect
units.summary: Select conversion record two using the common reset/setup path.

units.name: SpecialTimedEffectUpdate
units.summary: Select sprite pointers from even timer offsets. Outside global inhibition advance a finite frame/motion sequence; when the frame count reaches its configured limit merge the variant mask into global state and deactivate. Otherwise load signed high-byte velocities and integrate before rendering.

units.name: SpecialTimedEffectLoadVelocity
units.summary: Use the effect frame index to load signed horizontal/vertical velocity high bytes, then tail-call integration.

units.name: SpecialControllerAInitialize
units.summary: Enable the primary actor display, cache its bounds/origin fields, initialize shared control bytes and queue the fixed encounter transfer list. These shared bytes are controller flags/counters here, not normal linked-actor slot identities.

units.name: SpecialControllerAUpdate
units.summary: Unless globally/player inhibited, update control thresholds, inverse-scroll motion and periodic transfer animation, then integrate the primary actor and cache/wrap its X page. Terminal shared control converts the primary actor to the timed effect and blackens the palette.

units.name: SpecialControllerASelectPhase
units.summary: Use the controller frame to select low control bits and compare the two-byte scroll accumulator against phase-specific thresholds. On crossing, advance its frame modulo eight; one phase also arms a part action and clears its animation variant.

units.name: SpecialControllerAApplyScrollVelocity
units.summary: While movement is enabled load signed primary X velocity, subtract it from a three-byte fractional scroll accumulator and copy the resulting scroll/page bit into PPU shadows. Disabled movement tail-calls the shared motion reset.

units.name: SpecialControllerAAnimateTransfer
units.summary: While the control enables movement, every 32 timer ticks alternate a two-byte source pointer and enqueue its fixed PPU transfer. The primary actor sequence counter tracks the transfer frame.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartUpdate
units.summary: Initialize part display/frame attributes once. Normal updates service contact, trigger conditions, return arc, relative X/Y positioning, integration and finite part sprites. Terminal part status signals primary shared control before conversion; override uses the common actor recovery helper.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartCheckTrigger
units.summary: When the primary is on its first X page and in a supported control/frame phase, a zero random byte arms the part action and resets its variant.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartArc
units.summary: During the active shared-control phase, handshake a return flag, advance an angular velocity sequence every fourth step and test the part against the primary-relative target. On arrival stop motion and switch shared control to the next action phase.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartNearTarget
units.summary: Compare part X against primary X-$20 and part Y against primary Y-$40 using the bounded signed-distance helper with threshold eight; carry reports an out-of-window axis.

units.name: SpecialPartSignedWindowTest
units.summary: Add the supplied threshold to a signed two-byte difference, double the threshold and compare the shifted interval. The carry result is the consumer contract; endpoint inclusivity follows the exact carry-in sequence.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartVerticalMotion
units.summary: If shared action bits request it, either stop vertical motion or anchor the part forty pixels above the primary and alternate signed vertical increments from its frame counter.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartAnchorX
units.summary: Except during the detached action phase, keep the part X exactly 32 pixels behind the primary actor.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartContactReaction
units.summary: Service actor flash/contact damage and restore display/status when the reaction timer completes.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartAnimate
units.summary: While attached, anchor Y to primary Y-$40 and advance variant every sixteen ticks. Variant six arms the detached action; variant eight restores ordinary control. Sprite selection follows the variant, while the alternate control phase can spawn a three-part effect.

units.name: SpecialControllerAPartArmArc
units.summary: If the shared terminal-phase bit is clear, set the detached-action control bit and initialize angle/sequence counter. Otherwise clear that terminal bit and emit the three-part effect.

units.name: SpecialSpawnThreeType4BEffects
units.summary: Create three related type-$4B effects with timer variants zero, one and two. The shared initializer copies source X, fixes Y/display/sprite and frame attribute; callers rely on the accepted allocation contract.

units.name: SpecialSpawnType4BEffect
units.summary: Allocate and initialize one type-$4B effect from the source actor X, fixed Y $50, fixed sprite and frame attribute. The caller selects its timer variant after return.

units.name: SpecialType4BEffectUpdate
units.summary: Only under the matching shared work code, apply camera/contact/terrain/player-state checks, load fixed leftward velocity plus timer-indexed vertical velocity, animate, integrate and render. Terminal contact awards reward and removes the slot.

units.name: SpecialType4BEffectLoadVelocity
units.summary: Install horizontal velocity $FE00 and choose the two-byte vertical velocity from the timer variant.

units.name: SpecialType4BEffectAnimate
units.summary: Advance the frame counter and use bits two/three to select the effect sprite pointer.

units.name: SpecialActorFollowingPrimaryUpdate
units.summary: Before activation copy primary X/Y with a sixteen-pixel vertical offset and fixed display/sprite. Shared terminal control activates its leap. Normal active updates handle probes/contact, proximity/random actions, horizontal velocity, gravity, finite animation and integration; terminal status chooses the corresponding timed-effect record.

units.name: SpecialActorFollowingPrimaryProbe
units.summary: Build collision probe template zero and tail-call the alternate motion/collision helper.

units.name: SpecialActorFollowingPrimaryReaction
units.summary: On contact optionally start an upward leap from terrain, reverse facing away from the player and start the flash timer. At completion apply damage and restore display/status.

units.name: SpecialActorFollowingPrimaryChooseAction
units.summary: Require no reaction/action bits and supported terrain before facing the player. Random and nested distance checks select an attack or movement action, preserving direction bits and resetting animation when needed.

units.name: SpecialActorFollowingPrimaryHorizontalMotion
units.summary: Select signed horizontal velocity from direction and reaction state while motion is enabled. Stop at direction-dependent low-X bounds; disabled movement uses the shared reset helper.

units.name: SpecialActorFollowingPrimaryGravity
units.summary: Descending contact stops vertical velocity and aligns Y to eight pixels. Otherwise add $0040 acceleration, preserving ascent and capping descent at $0400.

units.name: SpecialActorFollowingPrimaryAnimate
units.summary: Advance the timer, choose reaction, walk or finite action frame groups, and clear/reset action flags at their respective frame limits. A designated attack frame advances variant and emits the paired projectile pattern.

units.name: SpecialActorFollowingPrimaryLoadFrame
units.summary: Add animation-group base to the low two frame bits and load a four-byte sprite/attribute/work record.

units.name: SpecialEmitPairedType4CActors
units.summary: Use source variant parity to emit two type-$4C actors with different vertical acceleration values. Each starts at source X, fixed Y $70, upward velocity $FC00 and copied direction/motion flags.

units.name: SpecialSpawnType4CActor
units.summary: Allocate the type-$4C child, copy source X and motion flags, and install fixed Y/display/sprite plus upward velocity. The caller fills its acceleration variant.

units.name: SpecialType4CActorUpdate
units.summary: Apply camera/contact/terrain/player-state checks, load direction-indexed horizontal velocity, accelerate vertically by its variant, animate, integrate and render. Terminal contact awards reward before removal.

units.name: SpecialType4CLoadHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Mask direction bit one to select the signed two-byte horizontal velocity pair.

units.name: SpecialType4CApplyGravity
units.summary: Add the actor variant to vertical velocity low byte, propagate carry and cap nonnegative descent at $0400.

units.name: SpecialType4CAnimate
units.summary: Advance the frame counter and select a sprite pointer from bits four/five.

units.name: SpecialControllerBInitialize
units.summary: Enable primary display, initialize controller flags, cache primary origin/bounds and queue the fixed encounter transfer list. The shared $0160 workspace has controller-specific flag/counter ownership.

units.name: SpecialControllerBUpdate
units.summary: Under supported global/player state service controller thresholds, pause/reposition sequence and inverse-scroll motion, integrate primary and cache/wrap its X page. Terminal control converts the primary to the shared timed effect and blackens the palette.

units.name: SpecialControllerBCheckScrollThreshold
units.summary: While moving compare the scroll accumulator with direction-specific limits. On crossing set the pause flag, disable movement and initialize a two-byte $0100 countdown.

units.name: SpecialControllerBApplyScrollVelocity
units.summary: While moving choose signed primary X velocity from control direction, subtract it from the fractional scroll accumulator and copy scroll/page into PPU shadows. Disabled motion uses the shared reset path.

units.name: SpecialControllerBPauseAndReposition
units.summary: While paused service the attack animation and decrement a two-byte countdown. At expiry reposition the primary on the opposite side, reset scroll and toggle direction for a second interval; the following completion restores ordinary movement. A control phase can also emit a projectile pair.

units.name: SpecialControllerBAdvanceAttackCycle
units.summary: Use shared phase/sequence bytes to arm a temporary animation bit and advance its four-step sequence every eighth timer tick. Clear it at sequence completion; another phase resets the attack counter and emits children.

units.name: SpecialControllerBPartUpdate
units.summary: Initialize part display/status once. Under ordinary global/player state position and animate the part relative to the primary, then render. Shared terminal control selects timed-effect conversion.

units.name: SpecialControllerBPositionPart
units.summary: Combine controller direction and low phase bits to choose primary-relative X offsets and fixed Y positions. Wrap the part X page to one bit and derive display facing from shared control.

units.name: SpecialControllerBSelectPartFrame
units.summary: Use low phase bits to load the part's four-byte sprite/frame-attribute record.

units.name: SpecialControllerBContactPartUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display/frame state, adjust reaction status from shared control and service contact flash. Position the part relative to primary and render its fixed sprite; terminal status sets the shared controller terminal bit and removes the part.

units.name: SpecialControllerBPositionContactPart
units.summary: Merge controller direction into display facing and add the matching signed X offset to primary X, wrapping its page to one bit.

units.name: SpecialControllerBContactReaction
units.summary: Service the standard status-controlled flash/damage sequence and restore display/status at timer completion.

units.name: SpecialControllerBDecorativePartUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display/frame state. Unless terminal/global/player inhibition applies, advance time, position from primary and select a two-frame sprite before rendering. Terminal controller state removes the part.

units.name: SpecialControllerBPositionDecorativePart
units.summary: Choose the signed primary-relative X offset from controller direction and wrap the resulting page to one bit.

units.name: SpecialControllerBAnimateDecorativePart
units.summary: Combine controller direction with the preserved display bits and select a two-word sprite frame from timer bit three.

units.name: SpecialControllerBEmitType51Pair
units.summary: Emit two type-$51 children whose acceleration variants are $20 and $30. Each inherits source position/direction, fixed Y $58 and initial upward velocity $FC00.

units.name: SpecialControllerBSpawnType51Actor
units.summary: Check a free slot, initialize type $51 and copy source position. Install direction from shared controller flags, fixed display/sprite and upward velocity; caller fills the acceleration variant.

units.name: SpecialType51ActorUpdate
units.summary: Initialize status and primary-relative position, then apply controller-terminal, camera/contact and player-state checks. Load direction velocity, terrain/gravity mode and sprite animation before integration/rendering; terminal contact awards reward and deactivates.

units.name: SpecialType51LoadHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Use motion bit one as the exact two-word horizontal velocity selector.

units.name: SpecialType51TerrainAndGravity
units.summary: Before the landed mode, sample terrain. Landing aligns Y, faces toward the player, sets the landed bit and stops vertical velocity; airborne motion adds variant acceleration and caps descent at $0400.

units.name: SpecialType51Animate
units.summary: Advance the frame counter. Airborne display flashes direction bits; landed mode instead selects a finite sprite sequence from counter bits four/five.

units.name: SpecialControllerCInitialize
units.summary: Enable primary display, cache primary origin/bounds, initialize controller flags and queue the encounter transfer list.

units.name: SpecialControllerCUpdate
units.summary: Under global/player gates update two-phase thresholds, inverse-scroll motion and part/attack sequence, integrate primary and cache/wrap X. A bounded random mask can emit another effect. Shared terminal control converts the primary and blackens its palette.

units.name: SpecialControllerCSelectPhase
