units.summary: While moving select direction bits from the primary frame state, compare scroll against two thresholds and toggle the frame modulo two on crossing. The fractional accumulator and page bit supply the comparison coordinates.

units.name: SpecialControllerCApplyScrollVelocity
units.summary: While moving load signed primary X velocity, subtract it from the fractional scroll accumulator and copy scroll/page to PPU shadows. Disabled movement tail-calls the common motion reset.

units.name: SpecialControllerCAnimateTransfer
units.summary: While moving, every 32 timer ticks alternate two transfer sources and queue the selected source at the fixed PPU destination. Sequence parity selects the source pointer.

units.name: SpecialControllerCPartUpdate
units.summary: Use the low motion bit to place a part at primary-relative X/Y and choose its sprite/attributes. Service contact/reaction and render. Terminal part state clears damage, changes its type and advances direction mode; after both modes complete signal primary terminal control and convert to the terminal type/display state.

units.name: SpecialControllerCPartReaction
units.summary: Service contact flash/damage and restore display/status after the timer. The following independent actor handler initializes its display and runs bounded horizontal/vertical movement, a slow child-emission timer and sprite animation.

units.name: SpecialType54ActorUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display/frame/work fields once. Normal updates service contact, rise/edge direction, signed X velocity, vertical sequence and slow direction phase, then integrate. Every 128 ticks attempt a child emission. Terminal state signals controller bit six and selects timed-effect conversion.

units.name: SpecialType54AdvanceDirectionPhase
units.summary: Increment a two-byte phase counter and map its high-byte bit two into motion direction bit one, preserving other flags.

units.name: SpecialType54RiseAndReverseEdges
units.summary: Mark airborne movement once Y is above $70 and stop its prior vertical velocity. Thereafter toggle horizontal direction when the actor reaches the low-X bounds $08/$F0.

units.name: SpecialType54LoadHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: While airborne choose a signed two-byte horizontal velocity using low motion bits; other phases preserve the current velocity.

units.name: SpecialType54LoadVerticalSequence
units.summary: Use a default vertical sequence offset before activation; after activation derive the even offset from timer bits two through five and load both vertical velocity bytes.

units.name: SpecialType54Animate
units.summary: Map direction into display-facing and alternate two sprite pointers from timer bit three.

units.name: SpecialType56ActorUpdate
units.summary: Unless controller bit six terminates it, initialize sprite, small downward velocity and saved X origin. Normal updates apply camera/contact/terrain/player gates, accelerated horizontal oscillation, integration and flashing display. Removal decrements the shared active-child counter; the later allocator respects its bounded count bit.

units.name: SpecialControllerCSpawnType56
units.summary: Unless the active-child count bit limits allocation, find a slot, increment the count and initialize type $56 with copied position/direction and fixed display.

units.name: SpecialType56InitialHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Choose signed initial horizontal velocity from the low motion bit.

units.name: SpecialType56OscillateAroundOrigin
units.summary: Compare current X with its saved two-byte origin. Accelerate horizontally by $0040 toward signed speed limits and reverse direction after crossing the origin according to motion sign. The following display helper flashes the active/display flags from timer bit one.

units.name: SpecialType56FlashDisplay
units.summary: Use timer bit one to alternate the effect's display bit six while retaining fixed active/attribute bits.

units.name: SpecialType57ActorUpdate
units.summary: Initialize frame attributes and fixed sprite once, placing the actor 32 pixels higher. Under camera/contact/player-state gates dispatch its falling/bounce mode and render; terminal removal decrements the shared active-child count.

units.name: SpecialType57RenderAndDispatch
units.summary: Render the actor or award/remove/decrement count on terminal contact. The following dispatcher masks the low motion bit, establishing exactly two mode words.

units.name: SpecialType57DispatchMode
units.summary: Use the low motion bit as the exact two-word selector for falling versus bounce initialization.

units.name: SpecialType57FallUntilTerrain
units.summary: Apply gravity, then when descending sample terrain. A negative terrain result advances motion mode, selecting bounce initialization next time.

units.name: SpecialType57ApplyGravity
units.summary: Add $0040 vertical acceleration and cap nonnegative descent at $0300, preserving upward velocity.

units.name: SpecialType57StartBounce
units.summary: Set vertical velocity $FB00 and advance the motion mode.

units.name: SpecialControllerCSpawnType57
units.summary: Respect the active-child count limit, allocate a type-$57 actor and copy source position/display. Initialize motion one and choose a signed horizontal velocity from two random bits.

units.name: SpecialType57SelectRandomVelocity
units.summary: Set the destination motion mode and select a two-byte horizontal velocity from a four-entry table using random low bits. Restore the source actor slot in X before returning.

units.name: SpecialControllerDInitialize
units.summary: Enable primary display, install its frame attribute, cache primary coordinates/bounds, initialize controller flags and queue the fixed encounter transfer list.

units.name: SpecialControllerDUpdate
units.summary: Service primary contact reaction before controller movement. Under ordinary global/player state update thresholds and inverse scroll, integrate/cache/wrap X and service proximity/random action sequencing. Terminal control selects the final timed-effect variant and palette blackout.

units.name: SpecialControllerDContactReaction
units.summary: On contact start flash/damage, set the controller reaction bit and signal terminal control if actor status becomes terminal. At flash completion restore display/status and clear the temporary controller reaction bit.

units.name: SpecialControllerDSelectPhase
units.summary: While moving choose control direction from primary frame state and compare scroll/page with two thresholds. Toggle primary frame modulo two at threshold crossings.

units.name: SpecialControllerDApplyScrollVelocity
units.summary: Load signed X velocity when movement is enabled, subtract it from the fractional scroll accumulator and update PPU scroll/nametable shadows. Disabled motion joins shared reset.

units.name: SpecialControllerDChooseAction
units.summary: Require ordinary control state, player distance/facing and random gates before arming a four-part action. Reset its control delay/phase bytes and step a mask sequence every eighth tick until its zero terminator restores movement. Another random path arms a single-child action only below the active-count limit.

units.name: SpecialControllerDAnimatedPart
units.summary: Place this part from the primary-relative offset template. During the shared action advance a finite six-frame sprite sequence at sixteen-tick intervals and set temporary status bits. Completion clears the control action, resets animation and allocates a child.

units.name: SpecialControllerDPartSelectFrame
units.summary: Select the part sprite from its frame counter. At frame six reset animation, clear the shared action bit and join the child allocator.

units.name: SpecialControllerDContactPart
units.summary: Initialize display/status once, anchor position from template offset four and mirror the controller reaction flash while its bit is set. Install a fixed sprite and clear the player's high state bit on the accepted X page before rendering.

units.name: SpecialControllerDInitializeFourParts
units.summary: Initialize four predetermined destination slots in descending order. A four-byte offset record positions each relative to the primary; the same loop index becomes its part/mask selector.

units.name: SpecialControllerDInitializePartRecord
units.summary: Add the selected signed X/Y offset to primary position and install type $5B, display/status and selector. X is the four-byte record offset; Y is the destination actor slot.

units.name: SpecialControllerDMaskedPart
units.summary: Render a part only when its selector mask intersects the controller phase and terminal control is clear. Set its fixed frame attribute/sprite and clear temporary status bit three; inactive phases set the $0E status mask without fabricating another actor state.

units.name: SpecialControllerDSpawnType5C
units.summary: Allocate a type-$5C child, increment the active-child counter, copy source position and install display/frame fields plus upward velocity $FB00. Allocation failure preserves state.

units.name: SpecialType5CActorUpdate
units.summary: Unless controller terminal state ends it, apply camera/contact/player-state checks, gravity/landing, horizontal target-window motion, integration and animation. Completed expiry decrements the controller active count and converts to its effect; other removal paths award reward and decrement once.

units.name: SpecialType5CGravityAndLanding
units.summary: Before landing add $0040 gravity with $0300 descent cap. At Y $A0 stop motion, save the player's current low-X target and a four-pixel window, choose facing and mark the approach phase.

units.name: SpecialType5CApproachVelocity
units.summary: Reset movement counters and choose signed horizontal velocity from direction unless attack/expiry mode bits stop ordinary approach.

units.name: SpecialType5CCheckTargetWindow
units.summary: While the approach flag is set, test low X against the saved four-pixel target interval. Inside it reset motion and enter the finite action-animation phase.

units.name: SpecialType5CAnimate
units.summary: Ordinary phase cycles timed four-byte sprite/attribute/display records. Action phase uses its frame index directly, advances every sixteen ticks and after eight frames enters expiry mode with a $F0 substate timer.

units.name: SpecialControllerEInitialize
units.summary: Enable primary display, set frame attribute, cache primary coordinates/bounds, initialize control flags and queue the encounter transfer list.

units.name: SpecialControllerEUpdate
units.summary: Under global/player gates update threshold direction and inverse scroll, integrate/cache/wrap primary X, then service proximity/random action choice. Terminal control selects the final timed-effect conversion and blackens the palette.

units.name: SpecialControllerEChooseAction
units.summary: If ordinary motion, require proximity, facing and a clear random mask before arming the shared part action and initializing three fixed part records. In the armed phase advance delay/sequence counters and clamp sequence to its terminal value two.

units.name: SpecialControllerESelectPhase
units.summary: While moving select direction from primary frame and compare the scroll accumulator against $00A0/$0060 thresholds. Toggle the frame modulo two at crossings.

units.name: SpecialControllerEApplyScrollVelocity
units.summary: Apply signed primary X velocity while enabled, subtract it from the fractional scroll accumulator and update PPU shadows. Disabled movement tail-calls the shared motion reset.

units.name: SpecialControllerEAnimatedContactPart
units.summary: Follow shared controller state to animate a contact part and queue frame-dependent PPU transfers. Ordinary contact reaction sets a shared damaged phase; finite attack frames arm a mask phase at frame six and restore movement at frame nine. Damaged mode resets animation, uses a fixed transfer and temporary status, waits through its timer and clears the damage accumulator before restoring normal control.

units.name: SpecialControllerEPartDamagedMode
units.summary: Initialize the damaged-mode transfer/status once, set control response bits and invoke the auxiliary conversion helper. Count down the part timer, then clear temporary actor damage/status and controller mode bits before restoring ordinary frames.

units.name: SpecialControllerEPartContactReaction
units.summary: Service contact flash/damage; terminal status sets the shared damaged control bit instead of removing the entire controller immediately.

units.name: SpecialControllerEConvertAuxiliarySlot
units.summary: Temporarily select slot $90, restore its X/Y from saved coordinates and convert it through the alternate timed-effect path, then restore CurrentActorIndex to slot $10.

units.name: SpecialControllerEContactPartUpdate
units.summary: Initialize display/status/frame attributes and place the part from primary offset template eight. Animate two sprites and service contact; terminal status sets shared controller terminal control and removes the part. Recovery can allocate another effect.

units.name: SpecialControllerEContactPartReaction
units.summary: Service contact flash/damage and restore display/status. On recovery completion invoke the bounded spare-slot child allocator.

units.name: SpecialControllerEInitializeThreeParts
units.summary: Initialize three fixed part slots using primary-relative four-byte offsets; the loop index supplies each part selector.

units.name: SpecialControllerEInitializePartRecord
units.summary: Add the selected signed X/Y offsets to primary position and install type $60, fixed display/status and the controller-part selector.

units.name: SpecialControllerEMaskedPart
units.summary: Require active shared mask phase and selector intersection with the sequence mask. Enable the part, install attributes and advance slow counters that can emit a spare-slot child. Select its sprite from the local frame counter; inactive phases restore the $0E status mask.

units.name: SpecialControllerESequencePart
units.summary: Render only during active mask phase at sequence value two. Anchor to primary offset template twelve, mark temporary status and advance a seven-frame sprite sequence at sixteen-tick intervals; terminal/inactive phases return without creating new state.

units.name: SpecialControllerEAllocateType62
units.summary: Use slot $70 if inactive, otherwise $80; if both active return. Initialize the selected spare slot as a type-$62 effect with fixed display flags. The following handler moves that effect upward while its controller remains active.

units.name: SpecialType62ActorUpdate
units.summary: Initialize its position from primary offset template twelve, service shared-terminal/status gates and move upward while animating. Remove when its Y high byte leaves the supported page or status becomes terminal.

units.name: SpecialType62MoveUp
units.summary: Install vertical velocity $FF00 and tail-call integration through the established current-object pointer.

units.name: SpecialControllerEAllocateType63
units.summary: Outside the shared mask phase use spare slot $A0 or $B0 if inactive. Initialize type $63 and fixed display; preserve both active slots when no destination is free.

units.name: SpecialType63ActorUpdate
units.summary: Initialize position by copying slot $50. Then apply controller/camera/contact/player-state gates, advance angular motion, integrate and animate before rendering; terminal contact awards reward and removes the effect.

units.name: SpecialType63SweepVelocity
units.summary: Every fourth tick derive directional velocity from the frame angle with magnitudes $06/$12. Alternate incrementing/decrementing the angle between zero and sixteen, switching its sweep-direction flag at those endpoints.

units.name: SpecialType63Animate
units.summary: Use timer bit three to alternate the two effect sprite pointers.

units.name: SpecialControllerFInitialize
units.summary: Enable primary display, install frame attributes, cache its coordinates/bounds, initialize controller flags and queue the encounter transfer list.

units.name: SpecialControllerFUpdate
units.summary: Under global/player gates update direction thresholds, inverse scroll and periodic transfers, integrate/cache/wrap primary X, advance a two-byte phase timer and select shared actions. Terminal control chooses the final timed-effect record and palette blackout.

units.name: SpecialControllerFSelectPhase
units.summary: While moving select direction from the primary frame and compare scroll/page against two thresholds. Toggle frame modulo two on crossing.

units.name: SpecialControllerFApplyScrollVelocity
units.summary: While enabled apply signed primary X velocity, subtract it from the fractional scroll accumulator and update PPU scroll/page shadows; otherwise tail-call motion reset.

units.name: SpecialControllerFAnimateTransfer
units.summary: While moving alternate two transfer sources every 32 timer ticks and enqueue the fixed PPU destination.

units.name: SpecialControllerFAdvanceTimer
units.summary: Increment the two-byte controller phase timer with carry into its high byte.

units.name: SpecialControllerFChooseAction
units.summary: At the supported timer boundary, require player-facing/progression/random conditions before choosing a shared attack action. Encode the selected action in controller flags and derive an auxiliary mode bit from timer high state. Terminal control returns without rearming.

units.name: SpecialControllerFAnimatedPart
units.summary: Initialize this primary-relative part and fixed sprite. During an armed action advance eight four-byte animation records every sixteen ticks; designated frames emit children or request shared player action $82. At sequence completion clear action flags and restore ordinary movement before rendering.

units.name: SpecialControllerFContactPart
units.summary: Initialize display/status/frame state, a two-hit phase counter and primary-relative position. Contact is enabled only under the controller mode bit. On terminal actor status either preserve the override-compatible case or decrement phase, reset damage/status and update subpalettes; after phase underflow set shared terminal control and remove the part.

units.name: SpecialControllerFContactReaction
units.summary: Run the status-controlled flash/damage sequence and restore display/status once its timer completes.

units.name: SpecialControllerFSpawnType67
units.summary: If a free slot exists initialize type $67, fixed display/frame attributes and a starting direction angle chosen from two random bits. Position setup belongs to its first update.

units.name: SpecialType67ActorUpdate
units.summary: Initialize at primary offset template twenty and install directional velocity, then service controller/camera/contact/player-state gates, motion state, integration and sprite animation. On supported terrain stop motion and enter a timed recovery phase; terminal contact awards reward and removes the slot.

units.name: SpecialType67MotionState
units.summary: Before landing, periodically aim toward the player while above Y $70. Terrain contact marks the landed mode and resets motion; after a 64-tick recovery choose player-facing horizontal movement and use its signed velocity pair.

units.name: SpecialType67Animate
units.summary: Alternate two sprite pointers from timer bit four.

units.name: SetPlayerOverrideAnimation
units.summary: When the incoming sign permits it, select motion bit4, clear the animation frame, seed its clock to $E0 and enable the override state; the negative path retains existing state.

units.name: TestPlayerAuxiliarySign
units.summary: Test the auxiliary player byte's sign before joining the existing update path; its precise gameplay ownership remains unresolved.

units.name: AdvancePlayerReactionAnimation
units.summary: Initialize the reaction, submit its animation resource and advance the frame when the clock low five bits clear. Frame bit1 latches global status bit7.

units.name: CheckThreePlayerAuxiliaryGates
units.summary: Continue only when all three auxiliary bytes are nonnegative and the scratch threshold reaches16; rejection joins the established early-return path.

units.name: InitializePlayerReactionClock
units.summary: Retain the low reaction nibble, set reaction bit3, start animation at frame0/clock1 and request sound $0E.

units.name: ActorFiveStatusGate
units.summary: Gate this actor's update on motion sign, the extension byte's low bit and status sign. The extension is actor-owned here, despite sharing storage with special scroll state.

units.name: ActorFiveContactTail
units.summary: Run the shared contact/status helper and tail into the common actor update; preserve the established actor-slot X contract.

units.name: ActorSharedStatusGate
units.summary: Use the same motion/extension/status gate for this actor family, with branches returning to its already reviewed update paths.

units.name: ActorSharedContactTail
units.summary: Apply shared contact/status handling before the common actor update.

units.name: LinkedActorStatusGate
units.summary: Gate linked-actor behavior by motion sign, the actor extension low bit and status sign; this does not expand the partial state table.

units.name: ClearSpecialControllerUpperFlags
units.summary: Keep only controller flag bit0, then join the common actor update.

units.name: AdvanceSceneTransferRow
units.summary: Retry a full transfer queue through the frame wait. On acceptance advance the source by32, count down rows and clear the active transfer when exhausted.

units.name: InitializeTwoRowTransferBuffers
units.summary: Set up two32-byte transfer buffers, reset their row counter and submit the descriptor-selected resource using the saved source pointer.

units.name: SubmitPairedSceneRows
units.summary: Submit both row buffers, advance their source between submissions and stop when the descriptor's row count is reached.

units.name: SubmitSceneRowAndWait
units.summary: Use the saved source pointer for the requested RAM buffer, enqueue its counted transfer and wait for consumption.

units.name: AdvanceSceneRowSource
units.summary: Advance the saved source word by32 with carry; this is a separate helper following the submission tail.

units.name: ExpandSceneMetatileRow
units.summary: A selects a16-entry layout row. Multiply each tile index by4, fetch its four tile bytes and place top/bottom pairs in the two transfer buffers.

units.name: LoadSceneTransferDescriptor
units.summary: Use the low six request bits to select four-byte resource and metadata records. Load source pointers, row count and a tile-definition offset relative to $8270; request bit6 marks initialization.

units.name: PollSceneStartAndChangeState
units.summary: Update scene transfers, rendering and sound, then poll newly pressed Start. Continue the wait loop until pressed and change main state to3. CD14 restores pair2/3 only.

units.name: PollSecondSceneStart
units.summary: Update transfers/rendering/audio and retry this scene's wait loop while Start is clear. Audio continuation relies on the supported pair2/3 return.

units.name: PollThirdSceneStart
units.summary: Service transfers, rendering and audio while waiting for newly pressed Start; continuation remains in pair2/3.

units.name: PollFourthSceneStart
units.summary: Service transfers, rendering and audio until Start permits the existing scene continuation.

units.name: PollFifthSceneStart
units.summary: Service the scene's transfer/render/audio work and branch back while Start is clear.

units.name: PollSixthSceneStart
units.summary: Service transfer/render/audio work and wait for newly pressed Start in this scene.

units.name: PollSeventhSceneStart
units.summary: Service transfer/render/audio work and retry this scene until Start is pressed.

units.name: PollEighthSceneStart
units.summary: Service transfer/render/audio work before the scene-specific Start gate.

units.name: PollNinthSceneStart
units.summary: Service transfer/render/audio work and repeat the existing wait loop until Start is pressed.

units.name: QueueAlternatingPeriodicTransfer
units.summary: X must be even0/2 to select a source word. Every fourth frame choose an alternating counted record; text flags $60 force the first variant. E666 consumes the count-headed record. Static structure is supported; a live caller is not established.

units.name: EnterPowerSelectionScene
units.summary: Initialize display, scroll, IRQ and rendering state, load scene resources and request audio $0D in effective pair12/13. Saved scroll values are restored on exit.

units.name: ClearPowerSelectionWork
units.summary: Clear32 scene work bytes, including SceneStep, then dispatch the initial finite state.

units.name: RunPowerSelectionFrame
units.summary: Wait for a frame, service rendering and scroll, and repeat until step5. Restore saved secondary scroll and the caller's control shadow before returning.

units.name: DispatchPowerSelectionStep
units.summary: Dispatch the low nibble through exactly five supported words. Initialization and handlers constrain steps0..4; the outer loop tests5 before dispatch. This is not a16-entry table.

units.name: MarkPowerSelectionStepEntered
units.summary: Set SceneStep bit7 as the current step's entry latch without changing the low-nibble selector.

units.name: PowerSelectionOpeningStep
units.summary: Start the first text resource once; when its completion bit is set advance to step1.

units.name: PowerSelectionChoiceStep
units.summary: Queue the choice display once, then map newly pressed direction bits to step2 or3 and issue the selection transfer.

units.name: PowerSelectionIndexStep
units.summary: Initialize the selection object and cycle its index through0..2. A pressed confirmation copies the index to ProgressionPowerIndex and moves to step4.

units.name: PowerSelectionMeterStep
units.summary: Initialize the second text sequence, then refill the secondary meter once per eight frames to20 before moving to step4.

units.name: PowerSelectionClosingStep
units.summary: Start the closing transfer/text sequence once. After its completion, countdown or confirmation moves to terminal step5.

units.name: RenderPowerSelectionObject
units.summary: Build the current object's descriptor and index-dependent frame, then use the common object renderer. The index is bounded0..2 by the selection handler.

units.name: LoadPowerSelectionTextDescriptor
units.summary: Multiply the descriptor index by4, load text source/destination words and clear the text cursor.

units.name: TickPowerSelectionText
units.summary: Every fourth frame copy one text byte to a one-byte transfer and increment the cursor. $FE marks completion and sets SceneStep bit6; this terminator belongs to this text format, not sprite tiles.

units.name: QueuePowerSelectionChoiceTransfer
units.summary: Submit the fixed counted transfer used after changing the selection step.

units.name: AdvancePowerSelectionScroll
units.summary: Every eighth frame apply a signed two-byte table delta to the main scroll. Clamp negative Y to zero and advance the delta selector each update.

units.name: LoadPowerSelectionPalettes
units.summary: Submit the two fixed palette resources through the established palette-copy helpers.

units.name: LoadPowerSelectionTiles
units.summary: Pass the scene's fixed resource pointer to the existing tile-loading helper.

units.name: ContinueAudioTestStop
units.summary: Call the existing audio stop/reset wrapper before the reviewed test-screen continuation.

units.name: SelectAudioTestBufferValue
units.summary: Copy the test buffer's first byte into AudioSelection and call the audio-selection wrapper. Return requires RAM08 to match the caller pair.

units.name: AdvanceAudioSelectionNine
units.summary: After the preceding helper, selection9 maps to10 through the existing selection routine; other values return to the test loop.

units.name: SelectHudCameraBand
units.summary: Search eight thresholds for the camera band, load its four-byte descriptor and initialize paired HUD positions before the existing HUD setup call.

units.name: QuantizeHudCameraY
units.summary: Normalize the camera Y word, divide the low component by16 and use the high-component parity to add15; return the compact band coordinate in A.

units.name: FindHudCameraThreshold
units.summary: Point the shared search helper at seven threshold bytes; its result controls descriptor selection, not a proof of wider HUD dispatch bounds.

units.name: LoadHudBandDescriptor
units.summary: Use Y times4 to load the HUD base position and two resource bytes from a fixed four-byte record.

units.name: RefreshHudOnBandChange
units.summary: If threshold search reports a changed band, reload its descriptor, reset both HUD positions and clear the request step.

units.name: HudLoadResourceAndAdvance
units.summary: Load the descriptor-selected resource, run the companion setup and advance HudRequests to the next supported step.

units.name: HudUpdateAndAdvance
units.summary: Run the existing HUD update helper then increment the request step.

units.name: HudSecondUpdateAndAdvance
units.summary: Run the second existing HUD update helper and advance the request step.

units.name: HudCommitScrollAndAdvance
units.summary: Perform the existing HUD action, copy its base coordinates to the scroll pair and advance the request step.

units.name: HudHiddenCoordinateTail
units.summary: Load $F0 as the off-screen coordinate used by the adjacent established HUD continuation.

units.name: ConsumeSecondaryMeterCost
units.summary: Index the cost table by three times progression index plus secondary selection. Subtract only when the signed result is nonnegative; an insufficient meter remains unchanged.

units.name: AddOneSecondaryMeterUnit
units.summary: Add one unit to the secondary meter and saturate at20.

units.name: SearchStageTransitionList
units.summary: Provide the five-byte stage-transition search table to the shared search helper. Its flags guide the caller's transition selection.

units.name: InitializeConsecutiveActorRecords
units.summary: Copy bounds and direction into consecutive16-byte actor slots, mark each active with type1/status $0E/frame $15, and repeat for the supplied count.

units.name: CallPowerSelectionBank
units.summary: Enter the supported pair12/13 scene routine. The fixed-bank continuation restores the caller's saved mapping separately.

units.name: RestorePaletteAndSavedBank
units.summary: Restore32 saved palette bytes, copy saved RAM12 to the main-pair shadow and map it at CA87. This replaces temporary pair12/13; it does not preserve it.

units.name: ResumePairZeroAfterSelection
units.summary: This continuation has the separately supported restored pair0/1 contract. Reinitialize display/IRQ state, restore saved low RAM and rebuild level display resources; do not inherit pair12/13 across CA87.

units.name: RestoreLowRamAfterSelection
units.summary: Restore saved bytes $0A..$12 into $00..$08 in reverse order, including the main-pair shadow.

units.name: StoreLivesAndSelectStateThree
units.summary: Store the packed lives count and choose main-state3 in the transition scratch byte before the existing countdown path.

units.name: ContinueLivesCountdownGate
units.summary: Use the preceding result's zero flag to select the existing countdown path; this branch does not independently compute a condition.

units.name: WaitThenChangeMainState
units.summary: Service rendering and wait for a frame, then change to the scratch-selected main state. The state changer resets the stack and does not return normally.

units.name: ChooseNextStageTransition
units.summary: Advance StageIndex, search its special transition list and choose normal state9, selector-table state or the final-stage audio path. Global status bit0 selects the alternate transition; state changes are stack-reset tails.

units.name: BuildStageTransitionDisplay
units.summary: Disable/clear display state, load level-indexed three-byte and eight-byte transfer payloads, submit two fixed text transfers and select the requested transition audio.

units.name: SecondaryTimedOverride
units.summary: Latch player override bits0/1, start an eight-bit countdown and periodically request sound $12. Low-bit initialization occurs only once; timer expiration clears the override.

units.name: SecondaryTimedSharedLatch
units.summary: Use shared-control bit6 to initialize the timed override once, then return to its common countdown path.

units.name: ClearSecondaryOverride
units.summary: Clear the shared secondary-control byte and player override state together.

units.name: SecondaryMovingPartsOverride
units.summary: Mark eligible actors, initialize eight moving part positions and their work record, then update their motion until the countdown expires.

units.name: SecondarySharedMovingParts
units.summary: Latch shared control, apply meter damage and seed eight part coordinates from the controller record before joining the common moving-part update.

units.name: SecondaryPaletteOverride
units.summary: Save16 background palette bytes and start a64-tick override. Alternate palette actions and restore the saved palette before clearing the override.

units.name: SecondarySharedPaletteOverride
units.summary: Apply shared meter damage, latch shared control and enter the same64-tick palette sequence.

units.name: SeedSecondaryPartsFromPlayer
units.summary: Copy the player's X/Y words into all eight part-position slots.

units.name: InitializeSecondaryPartWork
units.summary: Clear16 work bytes, install the part descriptor and set the32-tick countdown.

units.name: UpdateEightSecondaryParts
units.summary: Iterate eight saved positions backwards. Load each position and four-byte motion record into the common object work, update it and save the resulting coordinates.

units.name: MarkActorsForSecondaryEffect
units.summary: Scan all sixteen actor slots. Active actors lacking status bit1 gain bits4/6; this records an effect request without inventing its species-specific meaning.

units.name: ApplySharedSecondaryMeterDamage
units.summary: Latch player reaction bit7, subtract the controller's cost from the primary meter, clamp underflow to zero and choose sound $0D or $0E.

units.name: UpdateSecondaryTransitionEffect
units.summary: Initialize a transition once, clear48 work bytes and drive its object. Subsequent phases wait for camera/row conditions, rebuild spawn/row state and finish by restoring player state and mode bits.

units.name: InitializeSecondaryTransitionObject
units.summary: Install the transition object's descriptor and initial camera-relative coordinates in the shared work record.

units.name: MovePlayerThroughSecondaryTransition
units.summary: Move the work object toward the player's Y+11 threshold, then steer X into $22..$25. Latch each phase, stop vertical motion at alignment and finally set upward velocity and player state3.

units.name: JoinMainStateContinuation
units.summary: Tail into the established main-state continuation with its existing stack/state contract.

units.name: EnableDisplayHelperTail
units.summary: Load enable value1 for the adjacent established display helper continuation.

units.name: CallAudioControlAndResume
units.summary: Call the selected audio-bank control routine then join the global-status continuation. Returning to the caller's bank requires the saved main-pair contract.

units.name: ToggleGlobalAudioStatus
units.summary: Toggle global status bit7 while combining the auxiliary status byte, then request sound1.

units.name: LoadObjectVelocityForUpdate
units.summary: If the current object's active byte is negative, read its two velocity bytes into zero-extended scratch words and tail into the common object integrator.

units.name: SubtractPackedDecimalByte
units.summary: Store A/X as packed decimal operands and invoke one-byte decimal subtraction. Return the result on no borrow, otherwise zero; this emulates decimal arithmetic on the NES CPU.

units.name: SubtractPackedDecimalArray
units.summary: Subtract Y-indexed packed decimal bytes through scratch pointers. Correct low/high nibble borrows by $05/$5F, combine the digits and propagate carry for the supplied byte count.

units.name: RebuildLevelDisplayState
units.summary: Disable PPU output, clear render/HUD requests, retain level-mode bits0/2 and restore camera and level-resource state through the existing helpers.

units.name: RefreshCameraTileCoordinatesTail
units.summary: Refresh camera-derived tile coordinates before entering the established level-update continuation.

units.name: FinishFirstTileBufferLoop
units.summary: Advance Y to $C0 while returning to the established first buffer-fill loop.

units.name: FinishSecondTileBufferLoop
units.summary: Advance Y to $C0 while returning to the established second buffer-fill loop.

units.name: CommitHorizontalCameraBoundary
units.summary: Use comparison flags and camera nibble boundaries to decide whether to commit the candidate X word. Update mode direction/transfer bits only on a changed aligned column.

units.name: TestPreviousCameraColumn
units.summary: Compare the previous16-pixel aligned camera column against the candidate boundary, then join the established horizontal commit paths.

units.name: SetVerticalCameraMode
units.summary: Set level-mode bit4 to record the selected vertical scrolling direction.

units.name: ClearVerticalCameraMode
units.summary: Clear vertical scrolling direction bit4 without affecting other level-mode flags.

units.name: FollowPlayerLowerCameraBound
units.summary: Compute a camera target from player Y minus $A8, clamped at zero, and move only when the mode and signed comparison allow it.

units.name: FollowPlayerUpperCameraBound
units.summary: Use player Y minus $60 as the alternate clamped camera target. Existing row and control gates may disable following; direction controls which candidate is accepted.

units.name: TestPreviousCameraRow
units.summary: Clear the vertical direction bit, compare the preceding16-pixel row and join the vertical commit paths.

units.name: CommitVerticalCameraBoundary
units.summary: Respect the vertical mode and limit checks, compare the next aligned row and update mode/transfer bits when the candidate camera Y is accepted.

units.name: RefreshCameraRowCoordinates
units.summary: Normalize camera Y into the cached row-coordinate pair used by scrolling and transition checks.

units.name: PrepareCameraPpuRowAddress
units.summary: Derive tile/half-row indices and a nametable PPU address from normalized Y and the supplied X nibble; cache the camera's aligned row for change detection.

units.name: FinishFirstSixteenTileLoop
units.summary: Increment the tile index and repeat the established first tile conversion loop until16 entries are complete.

units.name: FinishSecondSixteenTileLoop
units.summary: Increment the tile index and repeat the second established tile conversion loop until16 entries are complete.

units.name: SelectMetatileHalfForRow
units.summary: Combine the incoming row value with tile-index parity, fetch the layout tile and tail into the shared metatile expansion path.

units.name: CopyRemainingMetatileCorners
units.summary: Copy the remaining three source tile bytes into the two row buffers; the caller has already written the first corner.

units.name: RestoreSavedCameraCoordinates
units.summary: Restore the four saved camera bytes into current X/Y coordinates.

units.name: FlushLevelTileBuffersToPpu
units.summary: Prepare palette/attribute state, clear the pending tile request and upload buffered rows or columns according to level-mode bit0. PPUCTRL selects increment direction; read PPUSTATUS before each address pair.

units.name: BoundedNoncodeContainer_00065a
units.summary: Animation/frame or PPU resource bytes, with pointer records and tile payloads identified by nearby consumers and repeated layouts. Four-byte frame records and count-indexed sprite tiles occur in this family, but some slices are two-byte pointer arrays; no universal four-byte schema is imposed. Sprite tile $FE means skip, not end. Exact game-specific frame identities remain unresolved.

units.name: PlayerMotionModeSetters
units.summary: Three separate player setters clear motion byte76; entries80C7 and80D2 select mode80=1 or0 before joining the established80F1/810F tails. Entry80DB only clears motion. The five-word dispatch prefix establishes these bodies, not all eight masked selectors.

units.name: PlayerMotionModeClear
units.summary: Clear motion and mode before the alternate player continuation.

units.name: PlayerMotionClear
units.summary: Clear motion before the common player continuation.

units.name: ActorCollisionVelocityUpdate
units.summary: Update vertical collision/gravity first, then choose horizontal velocity from contact flags.

units.name: SelectActorContactVelocity
units.summary: Inspect extended contact flags and the signed three-column collision probes. Choose one of the velocity words at89BD using facing, side contact and the saved direction bit; write actor velocity fields0A/0B. Exact actor-family meaning remains uncertain.

units.name: UpdateActorContactGravity
units.summary: When no upper contact flags are set, clear low position bits and the vertical-state flag on collision. Otherwise add half a unit to the signed vertical velocity, cap at4, or enter the existing alternate-state continuation. X comes from the current actor index.

units.name: ActorIntegrateThenAnimate
units.summary: Integrate the actor position, then call its existing animation/state helper. Both callees return under the main-pair contract.

units.name: ActorIntegrateOrDeactivate
units.summary: Integrate motion; extended state low nibble7 selects the shared actor tail using offset8. Other states continue the established handler.

units.name: ActorIntegrateContinuation
units.summary: Integrate position before the already classified actor continuation.

units.name: ActorTargetVelocityThenIntegrate
units.summary: Choose velocity relative to the saved target, then integrate the actor position.

units.name: ChooseActorTargetVelocity
units.summary: Compare the extended target coordinate with the current actor position. Use fallback word index16 when behind; otherwise use twice the low three state bits. Store the selected signed velocity word in fields0A/0B.

units.name: RestoreDisplayActorTail
units.summary: After the display-save routine restores the caller main pair, rejoin the established actor tail. This contract is conditional on the saved main-pair shadow.

units.name: WaitWithControllerCountdowns
units.summary: Wait for display/frame work, perform the established wrapper and read controllers. Preserve accumulator and flags while incrementing four countdown bytes until the frame counter changes; the following return restores both.

units.name: TriggerSecondaryOnObjectFlag
units.summary: If shifted object flags retain the high bit, request secondary effect6 and advance its phase. Otherwise return without changing that phase.

units.name: ResourceActorIntegrateContinuation
units.summary: Apply the fixed-bank actor integrator before the existing resource-bank continuation; the supported resource pair remains explicit.

units.name: TitleInputServiceContinuation
units.summary: Read title input, service both display helpers when button20 is held, then return to the title polling loop. No natural selector production is inferred.

units.name: TitleStartSelection
units.summary: A negative controller byte copies the menu choice plus1 to the request byte. Other input leaves the request unchanged.

units.name: HudRequestWaitReturn
units.summary: Keep waiting while the HUD request byte is nonzero; return once it has been consumed.

units.name: MarkHudRequestDirty
units.summary: Set the HUD request high bit while preserving its low request bits, then continue the existing handler.

units.name: InitializeMetersOnInput
units.summary: Negative input initializes both meter bytes to20; otherwise return without changing them.

units.name: QueuePairedHudRequests
units.summary: Issue HUD requests7 and8 with a frame wait between them, setting the HUD dirty flag each time; finish with request15 for the following continuation.

units.name: CheckRewardThreshold
units.summary: Mark the HUD dirty, compare the selected threshold with the current two-byte quantity, and stop onFF or a failed comparison. On success advance the threshold index, request28, and increment the packed-decimal reward byte unless already99. Exact reward identity remains uncertain.

units.name: IncrementMeterClampedTwenty
units.summary: Add lookupC5D4[0]=1 to meter91 and clamp results at20. Y stays zero and the branch reaches the local return; this is a single increment, not an additive loop.

units.name: ClearSceneContinuation
units.summary: Clear the scene transition state before the established continuation.

units.name: ReinitializeCameraTransition
units.summary: Run display, transition and HUD setup, clear the player subcoordinate, and join the established camera state.

units.name: RefillMeterOnButton
units.summary: Button20 fills meter93 to20; otherwise return without changing it.

units.name: PrepareSceneCameraAndDisplay
units.summary: Clear player mode/work state; derive player and camera setup from the scene selector. Disable selected rendering bits, perform scene/resource setup, initialize split flags and scroll, and enter the existing background transfer routine.

units.name: EnableSceneAndFrameServices
units.summary: Clear display/actors and prepare the scene. Install split/HUD and PPU shadows, enable display, wait a frame, perform the established scene helper, and tail-call the frame wait.

units.name: InitializePlayerCameraFromScene
units.summary: Map the low six scene bits through a setup index into four-byte records. Load player coordinates, camera origin=max(playerX-128,0), vertical state and a resource pointer. Derive a grouped descriptor index from scene-1, with a special first-scene index28; install its pointer, auxiliary byte and bank word.

units.name: RestoreDisplayAndAudioRequest
units.summary: Prepare display/transition state, install HUD/PPU shadows, copy the scene audio request, and tail-call the established audio wrapper. Its return restores the main pair from shadow08.

units.name: SceneTimerFallback
units.summary: Timer13 rejoins the existing wait branch; other timer values tail-call the fixed request helper with3.

units.name: ServiceFlaggedActors
units.summary: Map the main pair and scan sixteen16-byte actor records. Only active records with flag10 receive the two service calls; preserve the current index across them. Finish with the established actor dispatcher. Subsequent mapping depends on that dispatch.

units.name: ActorTailAtFieldEight
units.summary: Select actor field offset8 and tail-call the existing common operation.

units.name: InitializeResourceFourScene
units.summary: Under ResourcePrgPair4, MainPrgPair0 and selector0, clear display/CHR work and actors, then map resources. Physical01D557 / CPU D547 calls bank4 CPU8000: selector0 selects824F, the special-template initializer. Physical01D55A / CPU D54A calls MapMain; execution from physical01D55D / CPU D54D uses0/1. Natural production of this full contract is unresolved.

units.name: RunInitializedMainScene
units.summary: After the explicit MapMain call, initialize split/PPU shadows and the player through main-bank8000. Set player flags and audio request, then service frame, player dispatch, flagged actors, HUD and scene helpers before the established loop. This continuation requires MainPrgPair0.

units.name: AnimateMeterTransferSequence
units.summary: Request phase4, prepare display and clear32 phase bytes. Repeatedly service the two meter-transfer phases and HUD until phase83, then request phase3. Every eighth frame drain the two meters with reward/display updates, mark completion bits, and refill each toward20. Exact scene meaning remains uncertain.

units.name: ClearMeterTransferState
units.summary: Clear32 bytes beginning0556 and return.

units.name: DrainMeterTransferPhase
units.summary: Every eighth frame drain meter91 then meter93, updating phase bits and scheduling meter/reward display work. A negative phase has already completed draining.

units.name: RefillMeterTransferPhase
units.summary: Once the phase is negative, refill both meters toward20 on eighth frames, recording each completion bit.

units.name: RequestMeterSoundOnTick
units.summary: On eighth frames copy Y to the request byte; otherwise leave the request unchanged.

units.name: AdvanceNineteenChoiceSelection
units.summary: Negative controller input advances the choice and wraps19 to0. Other frames return without changing the choice.

units.name: ArmScanlineIrqTail
units.summary: Load the IRQ latch from the saved split value, enable mapper IRQs, advance split state, and join the fixed interrupt tail.

units.name: UploadIrqChrBanksTwoThroughFive
units.summary: The preceding code selected CHR register2. Upload shadows13..16 to registers2..5. These CHR-only writes retain PRG2/3; mapper register numbers are not effective PRG bank indices.

units.name: PollInputWithRepeatDebounce
units.summary: Save flags, A, X and Y before controller polling. Repeated nonzero low-nibble input increments the hold counter; changed or zero input resets it. Both paths join the established restore/debounce tail.

units.name: WaitFrameCountdownWord
units.summary: Wait one display/frame interval, decrement the low countdown byte and repeat until it reaches zero; then decrement the signed high byte. Exit when the high byte becomes negative.

units.name: ClearPpuIncrementMode
units.summary: Clear PPU shadow bit2 and return. Following entries are independent two-byte arithmetic helpers selected by zero-page index X.

units.name: AddByteToIndexedWord
units.summary: Add A to the indexed little-endian word, propagating carry into the high byte.

units.name: SubtractByteFromIndexedWord
units.summary: Save A as the subtractand and subtract it from the indexed word with borrow propagation.

units.name: AudioControlWithMainRestore
units.summary: Disable NMI, map audio12/13, call audio control8D29, explicitly restore the main pair from shadow08, and re-enable NMI. This does not establish an unconditional same-pair return.

units.name: TransferResourceThenRestoreMain
units.summary: Under the supported resource6/7 transfer contract, call the PPU dequeuer and then explicitly map the main pair. Resource-tail assumptions remain local to this entry.

units.name: IntegrateActorAlternateFields
units.summary: Set field offsets4 and6 and call the fixed integration helper twice with carry clear, using its alternate actor-coordinate contract.

units.name: ClearSpawnHistory
units.summary: Clear sixteen history bytes0576..0585. This11-byte helper follows the seven24-bit decimal powers; it is not an eighth table entry.

units.name: SplitBitIndexToByteMask
units.summary: Split input A into byte index X=A>>3 and one-hot mask A=1<<(A&7), leaving the decremented bit count in Y. Used for bitset addressing.

units.name: CameraResourceTransferContinuation
units.summary: Perform the fixed resource setup and transfer helpers, then join the established resource transfer tail. Preserve its explicit resource context.

units.name: SubtractCameraTilesUntilBoundary
units.summary: Subtract16 from the camera work word; stop when the high byte becomes negative, otherwise decrement the tile count and repeat through the existing helper. All called code is fixed-bank; resource6/7 is supported here.

units.name: ClearTransitionAndHideDisplay
units.summary: Clear the transition phase and call display-disable setup before the established continuation.
